200	- A transaction item is shown if its PageSecurity is in `AllowedPageSecurityTokens` and is not ''.
201	- A report item is shown if its PageSecurity is in `AllowedPageSecurityTokens` or is not set.
202	
203	## Order and failure
204	
205	**DeliveryDetails.php**
206	- A new order runs `GetNextTransNo(30)`, then the `salesorders` insert, then the `salesorderdetails` and work-order inserts, then `DB_Txn_Commit()`.
207	- Work-order inserts use `GetNextTransNo(40)`. The cost SELECT and the serial SELECT have no handler.
208	- Calls with an `$ErrMsg` re-raise to the caller (TrapErrors=true). The messages are:
209	  - "The order cannot be added because"
210	  - "Unable to add the sales order line"
211	  - "Unable to insert a new work order for the sales order item"
212	  - "The work order item could not be added"
213	  - "The serial number for the work order item could not be added"
214	  - "Could not update the new next serial number for the item"
215	- No handler exists on `WoRealRequirements`, on the email send, on `CalcFreightCost` failure, or on the second and third DB queries in the shipper fallback.
216	- An existing-order update runs `DB_Txn_Begin()`, then the contract updates if applicable, then the `salesorders` update, then the line updates, then `DB_Txn_Commit()`. After that the cart is unset and the links are output.
217	- Rollback on error is not shown.
218	- A source note says `$Asset['accumdepn']` is used where `$AssetRow['accumdepn']` was meant.
219	
220	**FreightCosts.php** and **PaymentTerms.php** run single statements with no transaction. A DB error is passed through the `ErrMsg` parameter.
221	
222	**index.php**: no handler for the `session_data` query error. It goes to the caller.
223	
224	## Connections
225	
226	- `webERP/SelectOrderItems.php`:
227	  - It sends the user to DeliveryDetails.php via redirect when `$_POST['DeliveryDetails']` is set.
228	  - DeliveryDetails.php sends the user back with the identifier ('Modify Order Lines') and at the end with `NewOrder=Yes`.
229	  - The cart in `$_SESSION['Items'.$identifier]` is shared.
230	- `webERP/RecurringSalesOrders.php`:
231	  - It receives `identifier` and `NewRecurringOrder=Yes`.
232	  - It refuses to continue if the cart is not set or `ItemsOrdered==0` ("A new recurring order can only be created if an order template has already been created from the normal order entry screen").
233	  - On Process it checks Is_Date on StartDate and StopDate and requires the end after the start. It also rejects a quotation.
234	  - It then inserts into `recurringsalesorders` and `recurrsalesorderdetails` in one transaction (header and lines).
235	  - Its frequency options are 52 Weekly, 26 Fortnightly, 12 Monthly, 6 Bi-monthly, 4 Quarterly, 2 Bi-Annually, 1 Annually.
236	  - AutoInvoice is offered only if `AllDummyLineItems()` is true. Otherwise it is hidden with value 0.
237	  - Update and delete operate on `recurrorderno`.
238	- `includes/DefineCartClass.php` and `EDIProcessOrders.php` also mention DeliveryDetails.php (not read).
239	- `freightcosts` table: written by FreightCosts.php. It is also read by `CalcFreightCost`/`FreightCalculation.php` (included by DeliveryDetails.php, behaviour not in this topic). FKs to `locations` and `shippers` apply on write.
240	- `paymentterms` table:
241	  - Written by PaymentTerms.php. Read by DeliveryDetails.php for the cash-sale check (joined to `debtorsmaster`).
242	  - Also read by `webERP/api/includes/api_paymentterms.php`, which selects `termsindicator` for the list and `SELECT *` by code for one term, with no escaping.
243	  - `debtorsmaster` and `suppliers` rows referencing a term block its delete.
244	- `custbranch`, `shippers`, `salesman`, `locations` and `locationusers` are read by DeliveryDetails.php.
245	- `salesorders`, `salesorderdetails`, `workorders`, `woitems`, `woserialnos`, `stockserialitems`, `stockmaster`, `bom`, `contractbom`, `contractreqts` and `contracts` are read or written by DeliveryDetails.php.
246	- `Shippers.php`: DeliveryDetails.php shows a link to it when no shippers exist.
247	- `menuitems.sql` lists FreightCosts.php and PaymentTerms.php under system Reports, and index.php builds menu items from it. `SecurityTokens.php` and `scripts.sql` also mention them (not read).
248	- Includes: `FreightCalculation.php`, `SQL_CommonFunctions.php`, `StockFunctions.php`, `CountriesArray.php`, `DateFunctions.php`.
249	
250	## Conclusions
251	
252	- Freight reconfirmation: when `DoFreightCalc` is on and the recalculated freight differs from the posted one, `OK_to_PROCESS=0`, so the first "Place Order" click never saves. The user must click again with the new value.
253	- Cash-sale check: `OK_to_PROCESS` is set to 1 by `InputErrors==0` before the payment-terms check. The terms check only sets it to 1 when both day fields are 0 (cash sale), so it never blocks credit-term customers. Non-cash handling is not coded.
254	- Quotations: no work orders are auto-created (`Quotation!=1` required). Only `MBflag=='M'` items with `AutoCreateWOs==1` get them.
255	- Contract conversion: it only happens on updating an existing order (`ExistingOrder!=0`) with `Quotation==0` and a `contracts` row at status=1. A second update finds status=2 and does not repeat it.
256	- Duplicate submission: the new-order path has no duplicate guard, so a repeat POST with the cart still set creates a second order number. The cart is unset only after success.
257	- Recurring orders: `RecurringSalesOrders.php` rejects quotations, so the `Quotation==1` check in DeliveryDetails.php produces the same refusal earlier.
258	- Validation: the cart-less branch and the POST branch can both bypass `custbranch` defaults, because POST values overwrite the cart.
259	- Payment terms: `DayNumber>360` is checked only when `DaysOrFoll` is checked. The unchecked case has no maximum.
260	- Freight costs: the numeric check cannot fail. Non-numeric input becomes 0 rather than being rejected.
261	- `freightcosts.destination` and the other columns have no uniqueness constraint, and FreightCosts.php has no duplicate check, so duplicate rate rows can be inserted.
262	- The `paymentterms` table has no FK from `debtorsmaster` or `suppliers` shown. The delete guard exists only in PaymentTerms.php, so `api_paymentterms.php` and other callers do not enforce it.
263	- `api_paymentterms.php` authenticates through `db($user,$password)` (NoAuthorisation on failure). PaymentTerms.php and FreightCosts.php show no check of their own.
264	- index.php shows no permission check on module links, and it does not validate `Application` against an allowlist.
265	- The email and work-order steps are inside the order transaction. An email failure is not handled and would abort the commit.
266	
267	## Hazards
268	
269	- SQL injection: the custbranch, default-shipper, paymentterms and `session_data` queries concatenate values into SQL without shown escaping. api_paymentterms.php does the same.
270	- The user-supplied `Application` GET value and `CompanyNameField` are not validated.
271	- The new-order path has no check that the debtor, stock IDs or location exist, and none that the order number is unique.
272	- The serial-number loop increments `WOQuantity` while looping, so the loop bound changes.
273	- Rollback on error is not shown for the order update.
274	- No permission check is shown on DeliveryDetails.php, FreightCosts.php or PaymentTerms.php. FreightCosts.php limits only the location list.
275	- The `$Asset` vs `$AssetRow` bug can break the work-order path.
276

# webERP order delivery details, freight costs, payment terms and main menu (DeliveryDetails.php, FreightCosts.php, PaymentTerms.php, index.php)

Part of [webERP: sales, purchasing, stock, manufacturing, master data, reporting, API…](weberp-sales-purchasing-stock-manufacturing-master-data-repo-151/brief.md) (path from the export's root): its brief says how work moves through the area and what repairs a failed step.

Four pages. `webERP/DeliveryDetails.php` validates delivery and freight details for a cart, then saves or updates the sales order or quotation. `webERP/FreightCosts.php` maintains the `freightcosts` rates. `webERP/PaymentTerms.php` maintains the `paymentterms` definitions. `webERP/index.php` renders the main menu. DeliveryDetails.php takes the cart from `webERP/SelectOrderItems.php` and hands off to `webERP/RecurringSalesOrders.php` and `webERP/SelectOrderItems.php`.

## Contract

**DeliveryDetails.php**
- It is reached by a meta-refresh redirect from `webERP/SelectOrderItems.php`. That redirect fires when `$_POST['DeliveryDetails']` is set, and goes to `DeliveryDetails.php?identifier=...`.
- It reads `$_GET['identifier']` and the cart `$_SESSION['Items'.$identifier]`.
- It reads these POST fields:
  - DeliverTo, BrAdd1-6, FreightCost, ShipVia, DeliverBlind
  - DeliveryDate, QuoteDate, ConfirmedDate
  - PhoneNo, Email, Location, SpecialInstructions, DeliveryDays
  - Comments, CustRef, Quotation (0 or 1), SalesPerson
  - ReprintPackingSlip
  - Buttons: Update, BackToLineDetails, MakeRecurringOrder, ProcessOrder
- It writes `salesorders` and `salesorderdetails`. Quotation numbers and order numbers both come from `GetNextTransNo(30)`.
- On new orders with automatic work orders it also writes `workorders`, `woitems`, `woserialnos`, and `stockmaster.nextserialno`.
- On converting a contract quotation it writes `contracts`, `bom`, `workorders`, and `woitems`.
- It calls `CalcFreightCost(total, BrAdd2..BrAdd6, totalVolume, totalWeight, Location, DefaultCurrency)`, which returns (FreightCost, BestShipper). (Behaviour not in this topic.)
- It calls `WoRealRequirements(WONo, location, stockid or contractref)` (behaviour not in this topic).
- It calls `SendEmailFromWebERP($SysAdminEmail, $_SESSION['FactoryManagerEmail'], subject, body, '', false)`. The body is "A new work order has been created for:\n" followed by `StockID - ItemDescription x WOQuantity Units`, then order and customer details, and reserved serial numbers if the item is serialised.
- It calls `CalcEarliestDispatchDate()` (behaviour not in this topic).
- It forwards to `RecurringSalesOrders.php` with identifier and `NewRecurringOrder=Yes`, or to `SelectOrderItems.php` with identifier.
- On completion it outputs links to these pages:
  - `PrintCustOrder.php?identifier&TransNo=$OrderNo`
  - `PrintCustOrder_generic.php?identifier&TransNo=$OrderNo`
  - `ConfirmDispatch_Invoice.php?identifier&OrderNumber=$OrderNo`
  - `PDFQuotation.php?identifier&QuotationNo=$OrderNo&orientation=landscape` and `orientation=portrait`
  - `SelectOrderItems.php?identifier&NewOrder=Yes`

**FreightCosts.php**
- It reads GET/POST `LocationFrom`, `ShipperID` and `SelectedFreightCost`.
- It reads POST `DestinationCountry`, `Destination`, `CubRate`, `KGRate`, `MAXKGs`, `MAXCub`, `FixedPrice`, `MinimumChg`. The numeric ones default to 0 if empty.
- It writes the `freightcosts` table. Columns:
  - `shipcostfromid` int PK auto-increment
  - `locationfrom` varchar(5), FK to `locations.loccode`
  - `destinationcountry` varchar(40)
  - `destination` varchar(40) default ''
  - `shipperid` int, FK to `shippers.shipper_id`
  - `cubrate`, `kgrate`, `fixedprice`, `minimumchg`: double default 0
  - `maxkgs`, `maxcub`: double default 999999
- It reads the `shippers` and `locations` tables. The location list is joined to `locationusers` for `userid=$_SESSION['UserID']` and `canupd=1`.
- It is linked from the `menuitems.sql` system "Reports" group, from `SecurityTokens.php` and from `scripts.sql` (not read).

**PaymentTerms.php**
- It reads GET/POST `SelectedTerms`, and POST `TermsIndicator`, `Terms`, `DayNumber` and `DaysOrFoll`.
- It writes `paymentterms` (`termsindicator` char(2) PK, `terms` char(40), `daysbeforedue` smallint default 0, `dayinfollowingmonth` smallint default 0).
- It reads COUNT(*) from `debtorsmaster` and `suppliers` by `paymentterms`.
- It is linked from the same `menuitems.sql` group.

**index.php**
- It reads POST `NewLogin` and `CompanyNameField`, GET `Application` and COOKIE `Module`.
- It reads session keys `UserID`, `FirstLogIn`, `DatabaseName`, `Module`, `ModulesEnabled`, `PageSecurityArray`, `AllowedPageSecurityTokens`, `Theme` and `CustomerID`.
- It queries `session_data` for the user's module value and calls `GetRptLinks($_SESSION['Module'])`.
- It sets a Company cookie and redirects to `InitialScripts.php`.

## Entry points

**DeliveryDetails.php, in order**
1. `if $_GET['identifier'] not set` -> error "This page can only be read if an order has been entered", footer, exit.
2. `if !isset($_SESSION['Items'.$identifier]) OR !isset(...->DebtorNo)` -> the same error, exit.
3. `if ItemsOrdered == 0` -> error "...if an there are items on the order", exit.
4. `if isset($_POST['ProcessOrder']) OR isset($_POST['MakeRecurringOrder'])` -> set `$_POST['Update']='Yes rerun the validation checks'` and store `OldFreightCost`.
5. `if isset($_POST['Update']) OR isset($_POST['BackToLineDetails']) OR isset($_POST['MakeRecurringOrder'])` -> run the validation block.
6. `if isset($_POST['MakeRecurringOrder']) AND $_POST['Quotation']==1` -> error "A recurring order cannot be made from a quotation" (the message is in RecurringSalesOrders.php).
7. `if InputErrors==0` -> run freight calculation and the branch lookup.
8. `if isset($_POST['MakeRecurringOrder']) AND !$InputErrors` -> forward to `RecurringSalesOrders.php` with `NewRecurringOrder=Yes`, exit.
9. `if BackToLineDetails == __('Modify Order Lines')` -> forward to `SelectOrderItems.php`, exit.
10. `if isset($_POST['ProcessOrder'])` -> check whether to process (see Decisions).
11. `if isset($OK_to_PROCESS) AND $OK_to_PROCESS==1 AND $_SESSION['ExistingOrder'.$identifier]==0` -> insert a new order.
12. `if isset($OK_to_PROCESS) AND $OK_to_PROCESS==1 AND ExistingOrder!=0` -> update the existing order.
13. No permission check is shown.

**FreightCosts.php**
- `if !isset($LocationFrom) OR !isset($ShipperID)` -> show the selection form.
- `if isset($_POST['submit'])` -> validate, then INSERT or UPDATE.
- `if isset($_GET['delete'])` -> DELETE.
- `if !isset($SelectedFreightCost) AND isset(both)` -> list the rows.
- `if isset(LocationFrom) AND isset(ShipperID)` -> render the edit form.
- No permission check is shown. Only the location list is limited by `locationusers.canupd=1`.

**PaymentTerms.php**
- On submit: skip the DB step if `SelectedTerms` is not set or `InputError==1`.
- `if SelectedTerms set AND InputError!=1` -> UPDATE.
- `if SelectedTerms not set AND InputError!=1` -> INSERT.
- `if delete` -> check dependents first.
- No permission check is shown.

**index.php, in order**
1. `if $_POST['NewLogin'] and !isset($_SESSION['FormID'])` -> `FormID = sha1(uniqid(mt_rand(), true))`.
2. `if $_SESSION['FirstLogIn']=='1' and isset($_SESSION['DatabaseName'])` -> redirect to `InitialScripts.php`, exit.
3. `if isset($_POST['CompanyNameField'])` -> set the Company cookie.
4. `if no stored Module` -> query `session_data` for the user's module.
5. Module choice: `$_GET['Application']` if non-empty, else `$_COOKIE['Module']`, else empty.

## Decisions

**DeliveryDetails.php validation**
- `mb_strlen(DeliverTo)<=1` -> InputErrors=1, "You must enter the person or company to whom delivery should be made".
- `mb_strlen(BrAdd1)<=1` -> InputErrors=1, street address required.
- `!is_numeric(FreightCost)` -> InputErrors=1.
- `DeliverBlind<=0` -> InputErrors=1, "You must select the type of packlist to print".
- `isset(DeliveryDate) and !Is_Date(...)`, and the same for `QuoteDate` and `ConfirmedDate` -> InputErrors=1, with a message naming `DefaultDateFormat`.

**DeliveryDetails.php freight and shipper**
- `$_SESSION['DoFreightCalc']==true` -> call `CalcFreightCost`.
  - If `!empty($BestShipper)`, set `FreightCost=round(result,2)` and `ShipVia=$BestShipper`.
  - Otherwise show a warn message with the freight value.
- `DB_num_rows(custbranch)==0` -> error "The branch details for branch code ... could not be retrieved", footer, exit.
- `!isset($_SESSION['Items'.$identifier])` -> fill the cart from custbranch columns (DeliverTo, DelAdd1-6, PhoneNo, Email, Location, ShipVia, DeliverBlind, SpecialInstructions, DeliveryDays, SalesPerson), and the dates, CustRef, Comments, FreightCost and Quotation from POST. Otherwise copy everything from POST, with `FreightCost=round(floatval(...),2)`.
- `isset($BestShipper) AND $BestShipper=='' AND (ShipVia=='' OR unset)` -> shipper fallback:
  - If the `shippers` row for `$_SESSION['Default_Shipper']` exists (`DB_num_rows==1`), use it as `BestShipper`.
  - Otherwise select all shippers and take the first row.
  - If there are no shippers at all, show an error with a link to `Shippers.php`.
- Final shipper choice: if the cart `ShipVia` is set and not `''`, `$_POST['ShipVia']` takes the cart value. Otherwise it takes `BestShipper`.

**DeliveryDetails.php processing**
- `InputErrors==0` -> `OK_to_PROCESS=1`.
- `FreightCost != OldFreightCost AND DoFreightCalc==true` -> `OK_to_PROCESS=0` and a warning, so the user must reconfirm the new freight. Payment terms are not checked.
- `FreightCost == OldFreightCost OR DoFreightCalc==false` -> read `daysbeforedue` and `dayinfollowingmonth` from `debtorsmaster` joined to `paymentterms`.
  - If `daysbeforedue==0 AND dayinfollowingmonth==0` -> cash sale, `OK_to_PROCESS=1`. A comment says credit card processing is not coded.
  - The same branch is the only one that sets `OK_to_PROCESS=1` from the terms check.

**DeliveryDetails.php new order insert**
- `GetNextTransNo(30)` gives `OrderNo`, then INSERT into `salesorders`, then INSERT `salesorderdetails` per line.
- If `Quotation==1`, show "Quotation Number ... has been entered". Otherwise show "Order Number ... has been entered".
- `MBflag=='M' AND $_SESSION['AutoCreateWOs']==1 AND Quotation!=1` -> check stock.
  - The shortfall comes from `GetQuantityOnHand`, `GetDemand` and `GetQuantityOnOrder` (all with 'ALL'), so that item and other-location stock count.
  - If `ShortfallQuantity<0`, create a work order from `GetNextTransNo(40)`.
  - `ShortfallQuantity + EOQ < 0` -> `WOQuantity = -ShortfallQuantity`. Otherwise `WOQuantity = EOQ`.
  - The cost is `SUM(actualcost*bom.quantity)` for the BOM at `DefaultFactoryLocation`. If it is null or 0, cost is 0 and a warning says the component cost is nil.
  - `Serialised AND NextSerialNo>0` -> create serial numbers. If a serial already exists in `stockserialitems`, increment `WOQuantity` and show an error. Otherwise insert into `woserialnos` and update `stockmaster.nextserialno`.
  - Then call `WoRealRequirements` and email the factory manager.

**DeliveryDetails.php existing order update**
- `UPDATE salesorders` sets debtorno, branchcode, customerref, comments, ordertype, shipvia, deliverydate, quotedate, confirmeddate, deliverto, deladd1-6, contactphone, contactemail, salesperson, freightcost, fromstkloc, printedpackingslip, quotation and deliverblind.
- Each line is updated (unitprice, quantity, discountpercent, completed, poline, itemdue). `completed=1` if `Quantity==QtyInv`, else 0.
- `Quotation==0` -> look in `contracts` for this orderno with status=1.
  - If one row is found: `GetNextTransNo(40)` gives `WONo`, `contracts.status` is set to 2 and `wo=$WONo`, rows are copied from `contractbom` into `bom`, and `workorders` and `woitems` rows are inserted.
  - The cost comes from `stockmaster` joined to `contractbom` and from `contractreqts`.
  - Then call `WoRealRequirements($WONo, Location, contractref)`.

**DeliveryDetails.php display**
- `count($_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens'])>1` -> internal staff links. Otherwise show the customer "Thank you for your business" message.
- `$_POST['Quotation']==0` -> packing slip links plus the `ConfirmDispatch_Invoice.php` link. Otherwise show the `PDFQuotation.php` links.
- The cart is unset before exit.
- Summary table: `in_array(2, AllowedPageSecurityTokens)` -> show the Item Code and Discount % columns. Otherwise hide them.
- Header is 'Quotation Summary' if `Quotation==1`, else 'Order Summary'.
- Defaults: an empty `Location` becomes `$DefaultStockLocation`. Unset `DeliveryDate`, `QuoteDate` and `ConfirmedDate` become `date('Y-m-d', $EarliestDispatch)`.
- `SpecialInstructions` is shown as an info message if its length is over 0.
- Line total is `Quantity*Price*(1-DiscountPercent)`.
- The location select uses `locationusers.canupd=1` and `locations.allowinvoicing='1'`. If the user has no such locations, no handling exists.
- Form: `$CustomerLogin == 1` -> hidden SalesPerson, DeliverBlind, FreightCost, ShipVia and Quotation fields. Otherwise visible inputs.
- `PrintedPackingSlip==1` -> ReprintPackingSlip select (Yes=0, No=1, with the last print date). Otherwise a hidden field with value 0.
- `DoFreightCalc` true -> show the "Recalc Freight Cost" button.
- `DeliverBlind==2` -> option 2 selected. Otherwise option 1.
- `Quotation==1` -> option 1 selected. Otherwise option 0.
- `ExistingOrder==0` -> buttons "Place Order" and "Create Recurring Order". Otherwise "Commit Order Changes".
- Country option is selected on an upper-case name match with `BrAdd6`. If `BrAdd6` is not posted, it matches the cart `DelAdd6`.

**FreightCosts.php**
- `!is_double((float)x)` for any of CubRate, KGRate, MAXKGs, MAXCub, FixedPrice, MinimumChg -> InputError=1, warning.
  - A cast to float always yields a double, so this check never fires.
- `SelectedFreightCost set AND InputError!=1` -> UPDATE `freightcosts` WHERE `shipcostfromid`, message 'Freight cost record updated'.
- `!isset(SelectedFreightCost) AND InputError!=1` -> INSERT, message 'Freight cost record inserted'.
- After a submit, the POST fields are cleared and `SelectedFreightCost` is unset.
- After a delete, `SelectedFreightCost` and `$_GET['delete']` are unset.
- The edit form loads the record into POST if `SelectedFreightCost` is set. Otherwise `FixedPrice=0` and `MinimumChg=0`.
- `DestinationCountry` defaults to `$CountriesArray[$_SESSION['CountryOfOperation']]`.
- `Destination`, `CubRate`, `KGRate`, `MAXKGs` and `MAXCub` default to ''.
- The listing shows 15 rows per screen page and repeats the header every 15 rows.

**PaymentTerms.php**
- `mb_strlen(TermsIndicator)<1` -> InputError, "The payment terms name must exist".
- `mb_strlen(TermsIndicator)>2` -> InputError, "must be two characters or less long".
- `DayNumber` empty, or `!is_numeric(filter_number_format(DayNumber))`, or `<=0` -> InputError, "must be numeric".
- `Terms` empty or `mb_strlen(Terms)>40` -> InputError, "forty characters or less long".
- `DayNumber>360 AND DaysOrFoll checked` -> InputError, "less than 361 days".
- `DaysOrFoll=='on'` -> `daysbeforedue=DayNumber`, `dayinfollowingmonth=0`. Otherwise `dayinfollowingmonth=DayNumber`, `daysbeforedue=0`.
  - With the box unchecked, a `DayNumber` over 31 is not rejected.
- Delete is refused if `debtorsmaster` has COUNT(*)>0 for `paymentterms=SelectedTerms`. The message gives the count.
- Delete is refused if `suppliers` has COUNT(*)>0 for the same term, with a count message.
- Otherwise `DELETE FROM paymentterms WHERE termsindicator=SelectedTerms`, message "The payment term definition record has been deleted".

**index.php**
- `$SupplierLogin == 1` -> show the supplier menu: view or amend outstanding offers, create a new offer, view open tenders without an offer. Exit.
- `$CustomerLogin == 1` -> show the customer menu: Account Status, Place An Order, Order Status. Exit.
- `ModulesEnabled[$i]==1` -> show the module link. The class is `ModuleSelected` if it equals `SESSION['Module']`, else `ModuleUnSelected`.
- Legend headers by Module:

| Module | Header 1 | Header 2 | Header 3 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `system` | General Setup Options (company.png) | Receivables/Payables Setup (ar.png) | Inventory Setup (inventory.png) |
| `hospsetup` | General Hospital Setup (company.png) | ERP Integration (ar.png) | Maintain types (maintenance.png) |
| other | Transactions (transactions.png) | Inquiries and Reports (reports.png) | Maintenance (maintenance.png) |

- A transaction item is shown if its PageSecurity is in `AllowedPageSecurityTokens` and is not ''.
- A report item is shown if its PageSecurity is in `AllowedPageSecurityTokens` or is not set.

## Order and failure

**DeliveryDetails.php**
- A new order runs `GetNextTransNo(30)`, then the `salesorders` insert, then the `salesorderdetails` and work-order inserts, then `DB_Txn_Commit()`.
- Work-order inserts use `GetNextTransNo(40)`. The cost SELECT and the serial SELECT have no handler.
- Calls with an `$ErrMsg` re-raise to the caller (TrapErrors=true). The messages are:
  - "The order cannot be added because"
  - "Unable to add the sales order line"
  - "Unable to insert a new work order for the sales order item"
  - "The work order item could not be added"
  - "The serial number for the work order item could not be added"
  - "Could not update the new next serial number for the item"
- No handler exists on `WoRealRequirements`, on the email send, on `CalcFreightCost` failure, or on the second and third DB queries in the shipper fallback.
- An existing-order update runs `DB_Txn_Begin()`, then the contract updates if applicable, then the `salesorders` update, then the line updates, then `DB_Txn_Commit()`. After that the cart is unset and the links are output.
- Rollback on error is not shown.
- A source note says `$Asset['accumdepn']` is used where `$AssetRow['accumdepn']` was meant.

**FreightCosts.php** and **PaymentTerms.php** run single statements with no transaction. A DB error is passed through the `ErrMsg` parameter.

**index.php**: no handler for the `session_data` query error. It goes to the caller.

## Connections

- `webERP/SelectOrderItems.php`:
  - It sends the user to DeliveryDetails.php via redirect when `$_POST['DeliveryDetails']` is set.
  - DeliveryDetails.php sends the user back with the identifier ('Modify Order Lines') and at the end with `NewOrder=Yes`.
  - The cart in `$_SESSION['Items'.$identifier]` is shared.
- `webERP/RecurringSalesOrders.php`:
  - It receives `identifier` and `NewRecurringOrder=Yes`.
  - It refuses to continue if the cart is not set or `ItemsOrdered==0` ("A new recurring order can only be created if an order template has already been created from the normal order entry screen").
  - On Process it checks Is_Date on StartDate and StopDate and requires the end after the start. It also rejects a quotation.
  - It then inserts into `recurringsalesorders` and `recurrsalesorderdetails` in one transaction (header and lines).
  - Its frequency options are 52 Weekly, 26 Fortnightly, 12 Monthly, 6 Bi-monthly, 4 Quarterly, 2 Bi-Annually, 1 Annually.
  - AutoInvoice is offered only if `AllDummyLineItems()` is true. Otherwise it is hidden with value 0.
  - Update and delete operate on `recurrorderno`.
- `includes/DefineCartClass.php` and `EDIProcessOrders.php` also mention DeliveryDetails.php (not read).
- `freightcosts` table: written by FreightCosts.php. It is also read by `CalcFreightCost`/`FreightCalculation.php` (included by DeliveryDetails.php, behaviour not in this topic). FKs to `locations` and `shippers` apply on write.
- `paymentterms` table:
  - Written by PaymentTerms.php. Read by DeliveryDetails.php for the cash-sale check (joined to `debtorsmaster`).

## Conclusions

- Freight reconfirmation: when `DoFreightCalc` is on and the recalculated freight differs from the posted one, `OK_to_PROCESS=0`, so the first "Place Order" click never saves. The user must click again with the new value.
- Cash-sale check: `OK_to_PROCESS` is set to 1 by `InputErrors==0` before the payment-terms check. The terms check only sets it to 1 when both day fields are 0 (cash sale), so it never blocks credit-term customers. Non-cash handling is not coded.
- Quotations: no work orders are auto-created (`Quotation!=1` required). Only `MBflag=='M'` items with `AutoCreateWOs==1` get them.
- Contract conversion: it only happens on updating an existing order (`ExistingOrder!=0`) with `Quotation==0` and a `contracts` row at status=1. A second update finds status=2 and does not repeat it.
- Duplicate submission: the new-order path has no duplicate guard, so a repeat POST with the cart still set creates a second order number. The cart is unset only after success.
- Recurring orders: `RecurringSalesOrders.php` rejects quotations, so the `Quotation==1` check in DeliveryDetails.php produces the same refusal earlier.
- Validation: the cart-less branch and the POST branch can both bypass `custbranch` defaults, because POST values overwrite the cart.
- Payment terms: `DayNumber>360` is checked only when `DaysOrFoll` is checked. The unchecked case has no maximum.
- Freight costs: the numeric check cannot fail. Non-numeric input becomes 0 rather than being rejected.
- `freightcosts.destination` and the other columns have no uniqueness constraint, and FreightCosts.php has no duplicate check, so duplicate rate rows can be inserted.
- The `paymentterms` table has no FK from `debtorsmaster` or `suppliers` shown. The delete guard exists only in PaymentTerms.php, so `api_paymentterms.php` and other callers do not enforce it.
- `api_paymentterms.php` authenticates through `db($user,$password)` (NoAuthorisation on failure). PaymentTerms.php and FreightCosts.php show no check of their own.
- index.php shows no permission check on module links, and it does not validate `Application` against an allowlist.
- The email and work-order steps are inside the order transaction. An email failure is not handled and would abort the commit.

## Hazards

- SQL injection: the custbranch, default-shipper, paymentterms and `session_data` queries concatenate values into SQL without shown escaping. api_paymentterms.php does the same.
- The user-supplied `Application` GET value and `CompanyNameField` are not validated.
- The new-order path has no check that the debtor, stock IDs or location exist, and none that the order number is unique.
- The serial-number loop increments `WOQuantity` while looping, so the loop bound changes.
- Rollback on error is not shown for the order update.
- No permission check is shown on DeliveryDetails.php, FreightCosts.php or PaymentTerms.php. FreightCosts.php limits only the location list.
- The `$Asset` vs `$AssetRow` bug can break the work-order path.

179	## Conclusions
180	- Dispatch lines with QtyDispatched 0 or empty skip all per-line stock, GL and log steps, but the line is still in the cart.
181	- The `isset(ProcessInvoice)` flag only makes the fields read-only. The form is the same page, and the Update versus ProcessInvoice submission handling is not shown.
182	- `$NegativesFound` blocks only when `ProhibitNegativeStock == 1`. Otherwise stock may go negative, because there is no check at decrement time. ASSET- lines are exempt from the negative-stock check.
183	- Dummy, kit and other mbflags other than B, M and A get no locstock change. They get a stockmoves row without newqoh.
184	- `CalcFreightCost` can return "NOT AVAILABLE", which is non-numeric, so the page sets freight to 0 rather than blocking.
185	- `CalcFreightCost` is called with BrAdd2 through BrAdd6, but its address check only needs one field set. The country is passed as the sixth argument.
186	- `EnsureGLEntriesBalance` absorbs small rounding differences into the largest GL line and rolls back for bigger ones. Because it is called after DB_Txn_Commit, the rollback has nothing left to undo.
187	- Reloading `?OrderNumber=` rebuilds the cart and drops unsaved edits. Re-submitting after success finds the order lines changed, or `quantity - qtyinvoiced` at 0, so a duplicate invoice is refused. With ProcessingOrder still set and no OrderNumber, the page does not stop at the first guard.
188	- BOPolicy 'CAN' cancels the unshipped balance and marks the line completed. Any other value (BO) leaves the line open unless fully dispatched.
189	- The salesanalysis match uses `cust LIKE`, `custbranch LIKE` and `stockid LIKE` with the plain values, so those values act as patterns.

# webERP/ConfirmDispatch_Invoice.php: confirm dispatch and create a sales invoice from a sales order

Part of [webERP: sales, purchasing, stock, manufacturing, master data, reporting, API…](weberp-sales-purchasing-stock-manufacturing-master-data-repo-151/brief.md) (path from the export's root): its brief says how work moves through the area and what repairs a failed step.

Loads an entered sales order into a session Cart, lets the user edit dispatch quantities, freight and taxes, then creates the invoice. The invoice is written across debtortrans, stock, GL, sales analysis and pick list records. It takes the order from the delivery details screen (`?OrderNumber=`). It calls the freight, commission and GL-account helpers and `ConfirmDispatchControlled_Invoice.php` for serial and batch entry.

## Contract
**In (GET):**
- `identifier` is the session key suffix. It defaults to the current Unix timestamp and is not validated.
- `OrderNumber` is cast to int.

**In (POST):**
- `ShipVia`, `ChargeFreightCost`, `InternalComments` (pattern `.{0,20}`) and `FreightTaxRate{i}`.
- `{LineNumber}_QtyDispatched` and `{LineNumber}{i}_TaxRate`.
- `Consignment` (max 20 chars), `Packages` (max 6 chars, default '1') and `InvoiceText`.
- `DispatchDate` (required) and `BOPolicy` (select 'BO' selected by default, or 'CAN').
- `ProcessInvoice`, which makes the quantity and freight fields read-only.
- `TransAfterDate`, converted by ConvertSQLDate.

**In (session):**
- `UserID`, `SalesmanLogin`, `RequirePickingNote`, `ProhibitNegativeStock`, `ProcessingOrder`.
- `CompanyRecord` (`decimalplaces`, `gllink_stock`, `gllink_debtors`, `commissionsact`, `currencydefault`), `CurrencyRate`, `DoFreightCalc`, `Default_Shipper`, `DefaultDateFormat`, `InvoicePortraitFormat`.
- `Old_FreightCost` is also listed as read by the freight section.

**Out (session):** `ProcessingOrder` = (int)OrderNumber and `Items{identifier}` = new Cart. Both are unset when the order is found changed.

**Out (DB, invoice number from GetNextTransNo(10)):**
- `custbranch.DefaultShipVia` is updated when it differs from the order's ShipVia.
- `salesorders` (comments, internalcomment, printedpackingslip).
- `debtortrans` with `type`=10, `trandate`=$DefaultDispatchDate, `inputdate`=date('Y-m-d H-i-s'), `prd`=$PeriodNo.
- `debtortranstaxes` has one row per tax authority, amount = $TaxAmount / CurrencyRate.
- `salesorderdetails`, `pickreqdetails.invoicedqty`, `pickreq` (status 'Invoiced', closed '1' where closed=0).
- `locstock` is decremented.
- `stockmoves` with `type` 10 and `qty` = -QtyDispatched. For B/M items it carries `newqoh` = QtyOnHandPrior - QtyDispatched; for other items it is inserted without `newqoh`.
- `stockmovestaxes`, `stockserialitems` and `stockserialmoves` (controlled items).
- `salescommissions` with `paid`=0 and `gltrans` with `type` 39 (two rows, using GetNextTransNo(39)).
- `salesanalysis` with `budgetoractual`=1.
- `orderdeliverydifferenceslog` (orderno, invoiceno, stockid, quantitydiff, debtorno, branch, can_or_bo).
- `gltrans` with `type` 10.
- `fixedassettrans` (transtype 10, 'disposal') and `fixedassets` (`disposalproceeds`, `disposaldate`).

Display only: the print link goes to landscape if `$_SESSION['InvoicePortraitFormat'] == 0`, otherwise portrait.

## Entry points
**Page load:**
1. `if !isset($_GET['OrderNumber']) and !isset($_SESSION['ProcessingOrder'])` -> error 'This page can only be opened if an order has been selected…', footer, exit.
2. `elseif isset($_GET['OrderNumber']) and $_GET['OrderNumber'] > 0` -> unset the old `Items{identifier}`, set `ProcessingOrder`, build a new Cart.
3. `if DB_num_rows($GetOrdHdrResult) != 1` -> 'This order item could not be retrieved. Please select another order', footer, exit.
4. `if DB_num_rows($LineItemsResult) == 0` -> 'There are no ordered items with a quantity left to deliver. There is nothing left to invoice', footer, exit.

No permission check exists beyond the header SQL. It requires `locationusers.userid = $_SESSION['UserID']` and `locationusers.canupd = 1`. If `$SalesmanLogin != ''` it adds `AND salesorders.salesperson = $SalesmanLogin`.

**Form update:**
1. `if sizeOf($Itm->SerialItems) > 0` -> QtyDispatched is the sum of the serial items' BundleQty.
2. `if QtyDispatched > (Quantity - QtyInv)` -> error 'Dispatched Quantity should not be more than order balanced quantity', footer, exit.
3. `elseif isset($_POST[{LineNumber}_QtyDispatched]) and is_numeric(filter_number_format(..)) and filter_number_format(..) <= (Quantity - QtyInv)` -> QtyDispatched = round(value, DecimalPlaces).
4. `if isset($_POST[{LineNumber}{i}_TaxRate])` -> TaxRate = value/100.
5. ShipVia, ChargeFreightCost and InternalComments are each set only if posted. FreightTaxRate{i} is divided by 100.

**Invoice processing:**
1. `if no lines with QtyDispatched > 0` -> error 'There are no lines on this order with a quantity to invoice', exit.
2. `if $_SESSION['ProhibitNegativeStock'] == 1`:
   - mbflag 'B' or 'M' (not an ASSET- stock id): `if locstock quantity < QtyDispatched` -> error 'Invoicing would result in negative stock', `$NegativesFound` = true.
   - mbflag 'A': the BOM components are read where effective-after <= CURRENT_DATE and effective-to > CURRENT_DATE. `if (quantity - (QtyDispatched * bom.quantity)) < 0` -> error for the component, `$NegativesFound` = true.
3. `if $NegativesFound` -> form end, exit.
4. `if DB_num_rows(salesorderdetails) != count(LineItems)` -> 'This order has been changed or invoiced since delivery started'. This unsets Items and ProcessingOrder, then exits.
5. For each salesorderdetails row, `if Quantity or QtyInv differ from the session line` -> error with detail, unset Items, exit.
6. DB_Txn_Begin().
7. Update custbranch if `DefaultShipVia != ShipVia`.
8. Update salesorders.
9. Insert debtortrans and debtortranstaxes.
10. Per line, only if `QtyDispatched != 0 and != '' and truthy`, run the per-line steps below.
11. Update pickreq, post header GL, DB_Txn_Commit(), then EnsureGLEntriesBalance(10, $InvoiceNo).

## Decisions
- **Freight block** (display, when `!isset(FreightCost) or FreightCost == 0`):
  - `if $_SESSION['DoFreightCalc']` -> `CalcFreightCost(total, BrAdd2..BrAdd6, totalVolume, totalWeight, Location, DefaultCurrency)` returns the cost and `$BestShipper`.
  - `if isset($FreightCost) and is_numeric` -> divided by CurrencyRate.
  - `if !is_numeric($FreightCost)` -> 0. The value "NOT AVAILABLE" is therefore treated as 0.
  - `if isset($BestShipper) and !is_numeric($BestShipper)` -> try `$_SESSION['Default_Shipper']` if it exists in shippers. Otherwise take the first shipper. If there are none, show an error with a link to Shippers.php.
  - `if isset($_POST['ChargeFreightCost']) and !is_numeric(filter_number_format(..))` -> 0.
  - `if Any_Already_Delivered() == 1 and (!isset(FreightCost) or $_POST['ChargeFreightCost'] == 0)` -> input shown with 0 and FreightCost = 0.
  - `isset($_POST['ProcessInvoice'])` -> FreightCost shown read-only. Otherwise an input is shown.
- **Freight tax:**
  - `if TaxOnTax == 1` -> amount = TaxRate * (FreightCost + FreightTaxTotal).
  - Otherwise -> TaxRate * FreightCost.
  - Either way the amount is added to `$TaxTotals[TaxAuthID]` and `$FreightTaxTotal`.
- **Dispatch date:** `if !isset($_POST['DispatchDate']) or !Is_Date(..)` -> `date(DefaultDateFormat, CalcEarliestDispatchDate())`. Otherwise the posted date is used.
- **Line display:**
  - `QOHatLoc < Quantity and (MBflag == 'B' or 'M')` -> row red.
  - `Controlled == 1` -> read-only if ProcessInvoice, else a link to ConfirmDispatchControlled_Invoice.php.
  - `Controlled == 0` -> read-only if ProcessInvoice, else an editable input (autofocus on the first).
  - `Serialised == 1` -> 'Enter Serial Numbers'. Otherwise 'Enter Batch/Roll/Lot #'.
  - `mb_strlen(Narrative) > 1` -> narrative row.
  - Line tax: `Tax->TaxOnTax == 1` -> TaxRate * (LineTotal + TaxLineTotal). Otherwise TaxRate * LineTotal.
- **Loading serials:** serial lines come from pickreq/pickreqdetails/pickserialdetails where `closed = 0`.
  - `isset(serialno)` -> a SerialItem is created with serialno and moveqty.
  - Else `RequirePickingNote == 1` -> QtyDispatched = qtypicked.
- **Line items loaded:** only lines with `quantity - qtyinvoiced > 0`, in orderlineno order.
- **Asset lines:** `mb_substr(StockID,0,6) == 'ASSET-'` -> `$IsAsset` = true.
  - The asset number is `intval` of the text after 'ASSET-' up to the next hyphen. If there is no second hyphen it is the rest of the string.
  - Otherwise `$IsAsset` = false and `$AssetNumber` = 0.
- **Back-order policy:**
  - `$_POST['BOPolicy'] == 'CAN'` -> `salesorderdetails.quantity = quantity - (Quantity - QtyDispatched - QtyInv)`.
  - If `Quantity - QtyDispatched > 0` on top of CAN -> log row with 'CAN'.
  - `!(BOPolicy == 'CAN') and (Quantity - QtyDispatched) > 0 and DateDiff(ConvertSQLDate($DefaultDispatchDate), DeliveryDate, 'd') > 0` -> log row with 'BO'. A BO line dispatched on or before the delivery date is not logged.
  - Both log rows record quantitydiff = Quantity - QtyDispatched - QtyInv.
- **Line completion:**
  - `QtyDispatched >= (Quantity - QtyInv) OR BOPolicy == 'CAN'` -> `completed=1`, `qtyinvoiced += QtyDispatched`, `actualdispatchdate`.
  - Otherwise -> only `qtyinvoiced` and `actualdispatchdate`.
  - If an open pickreq line exists (closed=0) -> `pickreqdetails.invoicedqty` is updated.
- **Stock by mbflag:**
  - 'B' or 'M' -> locstock decremented, stockmoves written with newqoh.
  - 'A' -> for each BOM component (effectiveto > CURRENT_DATE and effectiveafter <= CURRENT_DATE):
    - StandardCost is accumulated.
    - The component's locstock is read.
    - A stockmoves row is inserted and the component's locstock is updated.
    - The session line's StandardCost is updated.
  - Empty StandardCost -> 0.
- **Commission:** `Commission != 0` (from `CalculateCommission(SalesPerson, DebtorNo, Branch, StockID, DefaultCurrency, QtyDispatched*Price, PeriodNo)`) -> salescommissions row plus two gltrans rows of type 39. `Controlled == 1` -> stockserialitems updated and stockserialmoves inserted per SerialItem.
- **Sales analysis:** the count query returns `$MyRow[0]`.
  - `> 0` -> UPDATE salesanalysis (amt, cost, qty, disc).
  - Else -> INSERT salesanalysis from stockmaster and custbranch.
- **Cost of sales GL:** `gllink_stock == 1 and StandardCost != 0 and !$IsAsset` -> two gltrans rows of type 10. The COGS account is `GetCOGSGLAccount($Area, StockID, DefaultSalesType)` and the stock account is `GetStockGLCode(StockID)['stockact']`. COGS is debited and stock credited, with the narrative truncated to 200 chars.
- **Sales GL:** skipped when `gllink_debtors != 1 or Price == 0`. Accounts come from `GetSalesGLAccount(Area, StockID, DefaultSalesType)`, which returns `salesglcode` and `discountglcode`.
  - `!$IsAsset` -> sales credit of -Price*Qty/CurrencyRate.
  - `DiscountPercent != 0` -> discount debit of Price*Qty*Disc/CurrencyRate.
  - Asset lines: cost, accumdepn, costact, accumdepnact and disposalact are read from fixedassets joined to fixedassetcategories by assetid.
    - `accumdepn != 0` -> debit accumdepnact.
    - `cost != 0` -> credit costact.
    - `(cost - accumdepn) != 0` -> debit disposalact with the net book value.
    - The proceeds credit to disposalact is -Price*Qty*(1-Disc)/CurrencyRate.
    - A fixedassettrans 'disposal' row is inserted and fixedassets disposalproceeds and disposaldate are updated.
- **Header GL** (after the line loop):
  - `gllink_debtors == 1 and (total + FreightCost + TaxTotal) != 0` -> debtors gltrans row.
  - `FreightCost != 0` -> freight row.
  - `$TaxAmount != 0` for a tax authority -> tax row.
  - All header rows are type 10.

## Order and failure
- **Before the transaction:** the display and validation checks run first.
  - A negative-stock refusal or a changed-order refusal exits before DB_Txn_Begin.
  - The "changed or invoiced" refusal clears the session cart.
- **Transaction order:**
  1. DB_Txn_Begin.
  2. custbranch and salesorders updates.
  3. debtortrans, then DB_Last_Insert_ID, then debtortranstaxes.
  4. Per line: back-order and cancel log, salesorderdetails, pickreqdetails, stock, stockmoves, commission, serials, salesanalysis, GL.
  5. pickreq update and header GL rows.
  6. DB_Txn_Commit.
  7. EnsureGLEntriesBalance.
- **Error handling:** most DB_query calls pass an error message with the "CRITICAL ERROR! NOTE DOWN THIS ERROR AND SEEK ASSISTANCE" text and trap flag true. The handling inside DB_query is not shown in this file. No handler is shown for the line-item and serial query failures on load, or for DB_Last_Insert_ID.
- **After commit:** EnsureGLEntriesBalance runs after DB_Txn_Commit, so its rollback comes too late to undo the invoice. Failures in it are not handled here.
- **Loops:** no polling or retry.

## Connections
- **webERP/includes/FreightCalculation.php** `CalcFreightCost($TotalValue,$BrAdd2..5,$BrAddCountry,$TotalVolume,$TotalWeight,$FromLocation,$Currency)` returns a pair (cost, best shipper). This page passes BrAdd2 through BrAdd6 as the address fields.
  - It returns ("NOT AVAILABLE","NOT AVAILABLE") if any of these holds:
    - none of the address fields is set;
    - neither volume nor weight is set;
    - no location is set;
    - no currency is set.
  - It reads `freightcosts` where locationfrom matches, the country matches, maxkgs > weight, maxcub > volume, and the destination matches the city prefix or is ''. It starts at 9999999999 and picks the lowest of fixedprice, cubcost, kgcost and minimumchg.
  - No matching rows give "NOT AVAILABLE".
  - `TotalValue >= FreightChargeAppliesIfLessThan` (when that is not 0) gives 0.
  - Conversion: if Currency differs from `CompanyRecord.currencydefault`, the cost is multiplied by `currencies.rate` (1 if no row).
- **webERP/includes/SQL_CommonFunctions.php** `EnsureGLEntriesBalance($TransType,$TransTypeNo)`:
  - It sums gltrans amounts for the type and number.
  - Difference 0 -> no change.
  - `abs(Difference) > CurrencyTolerance(currencydefault)` -> prnMsg 'The general ledger entries created do not balance. See your system administrator' and DB_Txn_Rollback().
  - Otherwise it subtracts the difference from the gltrans row with the largest amount (grouped by counterindex).
  - `CurrencyTolerance` returns `pow(10, -decimalplaces)`.
  - Also used here: `GetNextTransNo`, `GetPeriod`.
- Other includes (behaviour not in this topic): DefineCartClass.php, DefineSerialItems.php, session.php, header.php, CurrenciesArray.php, GetSalesTransGLCodes.php (GetSalesGLAccount, GetCOGSGLAccount, GetStockGLCode), CommissionFunctions.php (CalculateCommission).
- **Linked page:** ConfirmDispatchControlled_Invoice.php receives controlled and serialised line entry (behaviour not in this topic).
- **Shared tables:** salesorders, salesorderdetails, debtortrans, pickreq, locstock and gltrans.
- **Sender:** the delivery details screen sends the user here via the "Confirm for invoicing" link (page not read).

## Conclusions
- Dispatch lines with QtyDispatched 0 or empty skip all per-line stock, GL and log steps, but the line is still in the cart.
- The `isset(ProcessInvoice)` flag only makes the fields read-only. The form is the same page, and the Update versus ProcessInvoice submission handling is not shown.
- `$NegativesFound` blocks only when `ProhibitNegativeStock == 1`. Otherwise stock may go negative, because there is no check at decrement time. ASSET- lines are exempt from the negative-stock check.
- Dummy, kit and other mbflags other than B, M and A get no locstock change. They get a stockmoves row without newqoh.
- `CalcFreightCost` can return "NOT AVAILABLE", which is non-numeric, so the page sets freight to 0 rather than blocking.
- `CalcFreightCost` is called with BrAdd2 through BrAdd6, but its address check only needs one field set. The country is passed as the sixth argument.
- `EnsureGLEntriesBalance` absorbs small rounding differences into the largest GL line and rolls back for bigger ones. Because it is called after DB_Txn_Commit, the rollback has nothing left to undo.
- Reloading `?OrderNumber=` rebuilds the cart and drops unsaved edits. Re-submitting after success finds the order lines changed, or `quantity - qtyinvoiced` at 0, so a duplicate invoice is refused. With ProcessingOrder still set and no OrderNumber, the page does not stop at the first guard.
- BOPolicy 'CAN' cancels the unshipped balance and marks the line completed. Any other value (BO) leaves the line open unless fully dispatched.
- The salesanalysis match uses `cust LIKE`, `custbranch LIKE` and `stockid LIKE` with the plain values, so those values act as patterns.

## Hazards
- SQL is built by string concatenation, with no parameterisation.
- The post-commit balance check cannot roll back an unbalanced invoice (see Conclusions).
- The CurrencyRate division has no zero check.
- No guard against negative QtyDispatched after rounding.
- If the transaction-wide error handling fails mid-way, partial records could remain, because the code shown relies on trapped DB_query errors only.
- `$IsAsset` is used in the sales-analysis GL block but defined elsewhere.
- The debtortrans comment about updating order lines when the balance is cancelled is cut off. Part of the code appears truncated.
- Serial entry is checked on load, but nothing re-checks that serial quantities match QtyDispatched for non-serial controlled lines.

1	# webERP recurring sales orders: template maintenance, due-order processing, and the sales integrity check
2	
3	Part of [webERP: sales, purchasing, stock, manufacturing, master data, reporting, API…](weberp-sales-purchasing-stock-manufacturing-master-data-repo-151/brief.md) (path from the export's root): its brief says how work moves through the area and what repairs a failed step.
4	
5	Three files make up this topic:
6	- `webERP/RecurringSalesOrders.php` creates, updates and deletes recurring order templates.
7	- `webERP/RecurringSalesOrdersProcess.php` is a cron or URL job. It turns due templates into sales orders and, optionally, invoices.
8	- `webERP/Z_SalesIntegrityCheck.php` is a read-only report on mismatched sales records.
9	
10	The template page takes its starting data from the order entry screen's session cart. The process job writes `salesorders`, `salesorderdetails`, `stockmoves`, `gltrans`, `debtortrans` and related tables.
11	
12	## Contract
13	
14	### RecurringSalesOrders.php
15	
16	**Input**
17	- `$_GET['identifier']` is the session cart key, `Items<identifier>`. It defaults to `date('U')`.
18	- `$_GET['NewRecurringOrder']` or `$_POST['NewRecurringOrder']` sets `$NewRecurringOrder` to 'Yes', otherwise 'No'.
19	- `$_GET['ModifyRecurringSalesOrder']` carries a `recurrorderno`.
20	- `$_POST['ExistingRecurrOrderNo']`, `$_POST['DeleteRecurringOrder']`, `$_POST['Process']`, `$_POST['StartDate']`, `$_POST['StopDate']`, `$_POST['Quotation']` and `$_POST['MakeRecurringOrder']` come from the form.
21	- `$_POST['Frequency']` takes one of 52, 26, 12, 6, 4, 2, 1. The labels are Weekly, Fortnightly, Monthly, Bi-monthly, Quarterly, Bi-Annually, Annually.
22	- `$_POST['AutoInvoice']` is 0 or 1.
23	
24	**Who sends to it (live callers)**
25	- `source/webERP/DeliveryDetails.php:276` redirects to `RecurringSalesOrders.php?identifier=<id>&NewRecurringOrder=Yes`.
26	- `source/webERP/SelectRecurringSalesOrder.php:98` links to `RecurringSalesOrders.php?ModifyRecurringSalesOrder=<recurrorderno>`.
27	
28	**Writes**
29	- `recurringsalesorders` header: debtorno, branchcode, customerref, comments, orddate (current date), ordertype, deliverto, deladd1-6, contactphone, contactemail, freightcost, fromstkloc, shipvia, lastrecurrence (from StartDate), stopdate (from StopDate), frequency, autoinvoice.
30	- `recurrsalesorderdetails` lines: recurrorderno, stkcode, unitprice, quantity, discountpercent, narrative.
31	
32	**Table definitions**
33	- `recurringsalesorders`: PK `recurrorderno` auto-increment. Foreign key (branchcode, debtorno) -> `custbranch`.
34	  - `frequency` is tinyint, default 1.
35	  - `autoinvoice` is tinyint, default 0.
36	  - `lastrecurrence` and `stopdate` are date columns.
37	  - `contactemail` is varchar(25).
38	  - `contactphone` is varchar(25).
39	  - `comments` is longblob.
40	- `recurrsalesorderdetails`: recurrorderno is a foreign key to `recurringsalesorders`. stkcode is a foreign key to `stockmaster.stockid`. unitprice, quantity and discountpercent are doubles. narrative is text.
41	
42	### RecurringSalesOrdersProcess.php
43	
44	**Input**
45	- `$_GET['Database']` or `$argv[1]` sets `$_SESSION['DatabaseName']`, `$DatabaseName` and `$_POST['CompanyNameField']`.
46	- Cron form: `php -f RecurringSalesOrdersProcess.php "weberpdemo"`. URL form: `?Database=weberpdemo`.
47	- The menu (`install/sql/data/menuitems.sql`) lists it as "Process Recurring Orders" under Sales > Transactions.
48	- `$_SESSION['UserID']` is used in the location filter.
49	
50	**Output**
51	- `salesorders`, `salesorderdetails`, `recurringsalesorders.lastrecurrence`.
52	- When `autoinvoice == 1`: `stockmoves` (type 10), `stockmovestaxes`, `salesanalysis`, `gltrans` (type 10), `debtortrans` (type 10), `debtortranstaxes`.
53	- An update to `salesorders.comments` appending ' Inv <InvoiceNo>'.
54	- An email advice.
55	
56	### Z_SalesIntegrityCheck.php
57	It is requested as a page and runs read-only SELECTs on `debtortrans`, `salesorders`, `debtortranstaxes`, `gltrans`, `salesorderdetails` and `stockmoves`.
58	
59	## Entry points and guards
60	
61	### RecurringSalesOrders.php
62	1. `if isset($_GET['NewRecurringOrder']) or isset($_POST['NewRecurringOrder'])` -> `$NewRecurringOrder='Yes'`, else 'No'.
63	2. `if isset($_GET['ModifyRecurringSalesOrder'])` -> load the template into the Cart. It selects `recurringsalesorders` joined to `debtorsmaster` and `salestypes`, and lines from `recurrsalesorderdetails` joined to `stockmaster` and `locstock`. Each line is added with `Cart::add_to_cart()`.
64	   - `else if !isset($_POST['NewRecurringOrder'])` -> error, exit.
65	3. `if (!isset($_SESSION['Items'.$identifier]) OR ItemsOrdered == 0) AND $NewRecurringOrder == 'Yes'` -> error "A new recurring order can only be created if an order template has already been created from the normal order entry screen", exit.
66	4. `if isset($_POST['DeleteRecurringOrder'])` -> DELETE `recurrsalesorderdetails` WHERE recurrorderno, then DELETE `recurringsalesorders` WHERE recurrorderno. Message "Successfully deleted", unset Items, exit.
67	5. `if isset($_POST['Process'])` -> validation, in order. Each failure sets `$InputErrors=1`:
68	   - `if !Is_Date(StartDate)` -> error.
69	   - `if !Is_Date(StopDate)` -> error.
70	   - `if Date1GreaterThanDate2(StartDate, StopDate)` -> "end date ... must be after the start date".
71	   - `if isset($_POST['MakeRecurringOrder']) AND $_POST['Quotation']==1` -> "A recurring order cannot be made from a quotation".
72	   - `if $InputErrors == 0` -> save. Otherwise no database work and the form is shown again.
73	
74	No permission check is shown on modify, delete or save.
75	
76	### RecurringSalesOrdersProcess.php
77	There is no authentication guard of its own; `session.php` is included.
78	- `if isset($_GET['Database'])` -> set the database name. `if isset($argv[1])` -> set the database name. The name is not validated, and the file carries @todo comments about a whitelist.
79	- Due selection query:
80	  - Tables: `recurringsalesorders` INNER JOIN `locationusers` (loccode = fromstkloc, userid = `$_SESSION['UserID']`, canupd=1), `debtorsmaster`, `custbranch`, `salestypes`, `locations`.
81	  - WHERE: `(TO_DAYS(NOW()) - TO_DAYS(lastrecurrence)) > (365/frequency) AND DATE_ADD(lastrecurrence, INTERVAL (365/frequency) DAY) <= stopdate`.
82	- `if DB_num_rows == 0` -> warn "There are no recurring order templates that are due to have another recurring order created", include the footer, exit.
83	- Otherwise it prints "The number of recurring orders to process is : N".
84	- Then it loops `while ($RecurrOrderRow = DB_fetch_array($RecurrOrdersDueResult))`.
85	
86	## Decisions
87	
88	### RecurringSalesOrders.php (`RecurringSalesOrders.php` main flow)
89	- `$NewRecurringOrder=='Yes'` -> `DB_Txn_Begin`, INSERT header, `DB_Last_Insert_ID('recurringsalesorders','recurrorderno')`, INSERT one `recurrsalesorderdetails` row per cart line, `DB_Txn_Commit`. Message "The new recurring order template has been added".
90	- `$NewRecurringOrder` is not 'Yes' -> UPDATE `recurringsalesorders` WHERE `recurrorderno=$_POST['ExistingRecurrOrderNo']`. Message "The recurring order template has been updated".
91	  - An update changes only the header; lines are not rewritten.
92	  - On update `StartDate` is a hidden field, shown as "Last Recurrence".
93	- `!isset($_POST['StartDate'])` -> default is today in `DefaultDateFormat`.
94	- `!isset($_POST['StopDate'])` -> default is today plus 1 day and plus 1 year.
95	- `AllDummyLineItems()==true` -> the AutoInvoice select (0=No, 1=Yes) is shown. `AllDummyLineItems()==false` -> hidden `AutoInvoice=0`.
96	- `$_POST[AutoInvoice]==0` -> "No" selected. Anything else -> "Yes" selected.
97	- `$NewRecurringOrder=='Yes'` -> hidden NewRecurringOrder=Yes and a "Create Recurring Order" button.
98	- `$NewRecurringOrder` is not 'Yes' -> hidden NewRecurringOrder=No, hidden ExistingRecurrOrderNo, an "Update Recurring Order Details" button, and a "Delete Recurring Order N" reset button with a confirm prompt.
99	
100	### RecurringSalesOrdersProcess.php: order creation
101	- Next date is `365 / frequency` days after `lastrecurrence`. The result is `$DelDate`.
102	- `DB_Txn_Begin`, then:
103	  1. INSERT `salesorders`. Error "The order cannot be added because".
104	  2. SELECT `recurrsalesorderdetails` INNER JOIN `stockmaster`. Error "The line items of the recurring order cannot be retrieved because".
105	  3. If `DB_num_rows($LineItemsResult) > 0` -> INSERT `salesorderdetails` per line, with `LineCounter` incremented. Error "Could not insert the order lines from the recurring order template".
106	  4. UPDATE `recurringsalesorders` SET `lastrecurrence=$DelDate`. Error "Could not update the last recurrence of the recurring order template. The database reported the error:".
107	  5. Commit.
108	- `autoinvoice == 1` -> invoice branch. The source text shown here is incomplete around where it branches.
109	
110	### Invoice branch
111	- Look-ups:
112	  - `custbranch` by debtorno and branchcode gives area and defaultshipvia. Error: "Unable to determine the area where the sale is to...".
113	  - `currencies` INNER JOIN `debtorsmaster` gives the rate. Error: "The exchange rate for the customer currency could not be retrieved...".
114	  - `locations` by loccode gives taxprovinceid, kept as `$DispTaxProvinceID`. Error: "Could not retrieve the tax province of the location...".
115	- `GetNextTransNo(10)` gives the invoice number. It runs `SELECT typeno FROM systypes WHERE typeid=... FOR UPDATE`, then `UPDATE systypes SET typeno = typeno + 1` (the rest of the function was not read).
116	- `GetPeriod(date(DefaultDateFormat))` gives the period. It parses the date by separators `/`, `-` or `.`, and has a `$UseProhibit=true` parameter that checks prohibited posting dates. The rest of its body was not read. It uses today's date, not `$DelDate`.
117	- `DB_Txn_Begin`.
118	- Per line:
119	  - `LineNetAmount = unitprice*quantity*(1-discountpercent)`.
120	  - Tax rates come from `taxauthrates` INNER JOIN `taxgrouptaxes` INNER JOIN `taxauthorities`, by the branch's taxgroupid, the dispatch province and the item's taxcatid, in `calculationorder`.
121	  - `if taxontax==1` -> `TaxAuthAmount=(LineNetAmount+LineTaxAmount)*taxrate`, else `LineNetAmount*taxrate`.
122	  - The amounts accumulate into `TaxTotals[taxauthid]` and `LineTaxes[$LineCounter][calculationorder]`.
123	  - UPDATE `salesorderdetails` SET `qtyinvoiced += quantity`, `actualdispatchdate`, `completed='1'`.
124	  - INSERT `stockmoves` with type='10', transno=InvoiceNo, loccode=fromstkloc, trandate=DelDate, qty = -quantity, standardcost='0', price converted by `CurrencyRate`, prd=PeriodNo, reference=OrderNo.
125	  - Read `DB_Last_Insert_ID('stockmoves','stkmoveno')`, then INSERT `stockmovestaxes` per `LineTaxes` row.
126	  - SELECT COUNT from `salesanalysis` matching ordertype, period, customer, branch, stock, category and `budgetoractual='1'`. If count > 0 -> UPDATE amt, qty and disc. Else -> INSERT `salesanalysis` from `stockmaster` and `custbranch`, with cost='0'.
127	- GL postings:
128	  - `if CompanyRecord['gllink_debtors']==1 AND unitprice!=0` -> `GetSalesGLAccount(Area, stkcode, ordertype)` (behaviour not in this topic) returns `salesglcode` and `discountglcode`.
129	    - INSERT `gltrans` type '10' on salesglcode, amount `-unitprice*quantity/CurrencyRate`.
130	    - `if discountpercent!=0` -> INSERT `gltrans` on discountglcode, amount `unitprice*quantity*discountpercent/CurrencyRate`.
131	    - COGS is deliberately not posted, because only dummy items are expected.
132	  - After the lines, if gllink_debtors==1 and TaxAuthAmount != 0:
133	    - `foreach TaxTotals` -> INSERT `gltrans` on `Tax['GLCode']`, amount `-FXAmount/CurrencyRate`.
134	    - `if TotalInvLocalCurr != 0` -> INSERT `gltrans` on `CompanyRecord['debtorsact']`, amount `TotalInvLocalCurr`.
135	    - `if freightcost != 0` -> INSERT `gltrans` on `CompanyRecord['freightact']`, amount `-freightcost/CurrencyRate`.
136	- Closing writes:
137	  - UPDATE `salesorders` SET `comments=CONCAT(comments,' Inv ',InvoiceNo)`.
138	  - INSERT `debtortrans` with type=10, transno=InvoiceNo, ovamount=TotalFXNetInvoice, ovgst=TotalFXTax, ovfreight=freightcost, rate=CurrencyRate, order_=OrderNo, tpe=sales_type.
139	  - `DB_Last_Insert_ID('debtortrans','id')`, then INSERT `debtortranstaxes` (debtortransid, taxauthid, taxamount).
140	  - `DB_Txn_Commit`, then `prnMsg` and the text is added to `EmailText`.
141	
142	### Email advice
143	- `if IsEmailAddress($RecurrOrderRow['email'])`:
144	  - `IsEmailAddress` returns false when there is no '@', when there is a `..`, and on component-length limits (rest not read).
145	  - From is `coyname<email>` of CompanyRecord. Subject is 'Recurring Order Created Advice'. Body is `$EmailText`.
146	  - `SendEmailFromWebERP` returns true or an error. If the send fails -> `prnMsg` error "Failed to send email advice ... to [email]". On success there is no output.
147	  - If `$_SESSION['SmtpSetting']==0` it takes a local-mail path; otherwise another path (not read).
148	- Else -> warn 'No email advice sent, location has no email contact with valid email address'.
149	- The `email` read here comes from the joined row. Whether it comes from the location or the template's `contactemail` is not shown.
150	
151	### Z_SalesIntegrityCheck.php (each a report line, no change)
152	- type 10 `debtortrans` with no `salesorders` orderno -> "No Sales Order".
153	- type 10 `debtortrans` with no `debtortranstaxes` -> "Has no Tax Entry".
154	- type 10 `debtortrans` with no `gltrans` type 10 -> "has no GL Entry".
155	- `gltrans` type 10 with no `debtortrans` type 10 -> "Invoice could not be found".
156	- type 12 `gltrans` on `debtorsact` whose total does not balance against `debtortrans` type 12 `ovamount` -> reports the amounts.
157	- `debtortrans` type 12 with no `gltrans` type 12 -> "not found in GL".
158	- `salesorders` with no `debtortrans` type 10 -> "Has no Invoice".
159	- `salesorderdetails` with no `salesorders` -> "Has no Sales Order".
160	- `salesorderdetails` invoice total differing from `debtortrans` `ovamount` where the `debtortrans` type != 11 -> "Debtors trans differ from salesorderdetails".
161	- `stockmoves` transno with no `debtortrans` type 10 or 11 -> "Has no Invoice".
162	- `debtortranstaxes` with no `debtortrans` type 10 or 11 -> "Has no Invoice".
163	
164	## Order and failure
165	- Template save: the insert is wrapped in `DB_Txn_Begin` ... `DB_Txn_Commit`. The header and line inserts pass `$ErrMsg` 'The recurring order cannot be added because'. A failing DB_query reports and stops, and the transaction is not committed. The update path has no transaction.
166	- Template delete: lines are deleted first, then the header. There are no explicit transactions or error handlers.
167	- The process job's order creation is transactional: a failed `salesorderdetails` insert stops later steps, including the `lastrecurrence` update and the commit.
168	- Invoicing: every `DB_query` passes `CRITICAL ERROR ... NOTE DOWN THIS ERROR AND SEEK ASSISTANCE` with a specific reason. The error handling is done inside `DB_query`, which is not in this topic. The GL-posting chunk and the per-line chunk have no transaction wrapper of their own, but `DB_Txn_Begin` is called before the per-line loop.
169	- Nothing handles failures of `GetNextTransNo`, `GetPeriod`, `InsertGLTags`, `DB_Last_Insert_ID` or `DB_Txn_Commit`.
170	- The email step runs after the commit. Its failure only prints a message, and the invoice stays.
171	- The job loops once over each due template. It has no retry. Templates that fail are picked up again on the next run if `lastrecurrence` was not updated.
172	
173	## Connections
174	- `webERP/DeliveryDetails.php` sends the user to the template page with `identifier` and `NewRecurringOrder=Yes`. The session cart `Items<identifier>` is the data carrier.
175	- `webERP/SelectRecurringSalesOrder.php` links to modify, with `ModifyRecurringSalesOrder=<recurrorderno>`.
176	- `webERP/includes/ConnectDB_mysqli.php`, `ConnectDB_mysql.php` and `ConnectDB_mariadb.php` carry a comment that they handle `$_SESSION['DatabaseName']` for cron runs of `RecurringSalesOrdersProcess.php`. Each file has a @todo asking whether that is needed.
177	- `webERP/includes/SQL_CommonFunctions.php` provides `GetNextTransNo`, which uses table `systypes`.
178	- `webERP/includes/DateFunctions.php` provides `GetPeriod`.
179	- `webERP/includes/MiscFunctions.php` provides `IsEmailAddress` and `SendEmailFromWebERP`.
180	- Tables shared with other parts: `custbranch`, `stockmaster`, `locstock`, `locations`, `locationusers`, `debtorsmaster`, `salestypes`, `salesorders`, `salesorderdetails`, `stockmoves`, `stockmovestaxes`, `salesanalysis`, `gltrans`, `debtortrans`, `debtortranstaxes`, `taxauthrates`, `taxgrouptaxes`, `taxauthorities`, `currencies`, `systypes`.
181	- The recurring tables are also referenced by Z_ChangeBranchCode.php, Z_ChangeCustomerCode.php and Z_ChangeLocationCode.php. Those files were not read.
182	- `webERP/Z_SalesIntegrityCheck.php` checks the records that the invoice branch writes. It is not called by the other files.
183	
184	## Conclusions
185	- The due test, `(TO_DAYS(NOW()) - TO_DAYS(lastrecurrence)) > 365/frequency`, uses days. A monthly template (12) is due after more than 30.4 days, a weekly one (52) after more than 7.02 days, and an annual one (1) after more than 365 days.
186	- The second due condition, `lastrecurrence + 365/frequency days <= stopdate`, drops templates whose next date falls after `stopdate`. So a template stops generating before `stopdate`, and expired templates are never picked up.
187	- `DB_num_rows == 0` ends the run with only a warning. Nothing else runs.
188	- The locationusers join with `canupd=1` for `$_SESSION['UserID']` means the run only processes templates whose `fromstkloc` that user may update. When it runs from cron with no logged-in user, which templates are seen depends on that session user. Templates at other locations are silently left unprocessed.
189	- Each run creates at most one order per template (one `lastrecurrence` step). A template that is far behind catches up one period per run.
190	- `lastrecurrence` is set to `$DelDate`, and `GetPeriod` uses today's date. The order is dated at the computed recurrence date and the posting period is the current one.
191	- The same template run twice in a row: after a success `lastrecurrence` has advanced, so the second run does not create a second order. If the commit failed, the first order is not kept and the template is picked up again.
192	- `frequency` is stored as tinyint. The code divides `365 / frequency` with no check for zero. The form only offers 52, 26, 12, 6, 4, 2, 1, but the form does not validate posted values.
193	- The `AutoInvoice` choice is only offered when `AllDummyLineItems()` is true, so stocked items are never invoiced automatically through this path. Otherwise the hidden value is 0. The invoice branch posts no COGS, which fits that restriction. But the process job re-tests only `autoinvoice == 1` from the template, and a posted `AutoInvoice=1` is not re-checked against the lines when saved.
194	- Update of a template writes only the header. Line changes made in the cart are not written to `recurrsalesorderdetails` on update.
195	- The quotation check tests `isset($_POST['MakeRecurringOrder']) AND $_POST['Quotation']==1`. When `MakeRecurringOrder` is not posted, a quotation template is not refused.
196	- `contactemail` is varchar(25). Longer addresses are truncated or rejected, depending on the SQL mode.
197	- The integrity check reports problems the invoicing branch can create. Examples are an order without a debtortrans, or a debtortrans without GL, when a step fails with no wrapping transaction. The check reports lines only and repairs nothing.
198	- The `salesorderdetails` total test excludes only debtortrans type 11. So type 10 invoices are compared, as are types other than 11.
199	- Z_SalesIntegrityCheck has no guard: any caller that reaches the page gets the report.
200	- Changing the recurring table columns would not change `Z_ChangeBranchCode.php`, `Z_ChangeCustomerCode.php` or `Z_ChangeLocationCode.php`, which keep their own references to these tables.
201	
202	## Hazards
203	- Database name from `$_GET['Database']` or `$argv[1]` is unvalidated, and it chooses the company database for the whole run.
204	- No permission check on template create, modify or delete. Any user who reaches the page can change or delete any `recurrorderno`.
205	- The tax-GL block is gated by `TaxAuthAmount != 0` and `gllink_debtors==1`. With gllink_debtors off no `gltrans` rows are written, while `debtortrans`, `stockmoves` and `salesanalysis` still are.
206	- The debtors-account and freight GL inserts sit inside the `TaxAuthAmount != 0` gate in the source text given. A zero-tax invoice then posts no debtors or freight GL lines, so GL for that invoice would be missing or unbalanced (this reading follows the RULE text).
207	- Delete removes details then header with no transaction. A failure between them leaves a header with no lines.
208	- The email send runs after the commit, so a send failure never undoes the invoice. It is only printed.
209	- An empty template (no lines) can be saved. The line loop simply inserts nothing.
210	- No check that the customer, stock items or locations still exist when the job runs. The foreign keys on the tables are the only guard.
211	- Prices and quantities are not tested for being non-negative.
212	- No duplicate guard on `InvoiceNo` beyond `systypes` numbering.
213
