function InvoiceSalesOrder($OrderNo, $User, $Password) {

	$Errors = array();
	$db = db($User, $Password);
	if (gettype($db)=='integer') {
		$Errors[]=NoAuthorisation;
		return $Errors;
	}
	$Errors=VerifyOrderHeaderExists($OrderNo, sizeof($Errors), $Errors);
	if (sizeof($Errors)!=0) {
		return $Errors;
	}
	/*Does not deal with assembly items or serialise/lot track items - for use by POS */
	/*Get Company Defaults */
	$ReadCoyResult = api_DB_query("SELECT debtorsact,
											freightact,
											gllink_debtors,
											gllink_stock
									FROM companies
									WHERE coycode=1");

	$CompanyRecord = DB_fetch_array($ReadCoyResult);
	if (DB_error_no() != 0) {
		$Errors[] = NoCompanyRecord;
	}

	$OrderHeaderSQL = "SELECT salesorders.debtorno,
							  debtorsmaster.name,
							  salesorders.branchcode,
							  salesorders.customerref,
							  salesorders.orddate,
							  salesorders.ordertype,
							  salesorders.shipvia,
							  custbranch.area,
							  custbranch.taxgroupid,
							  debtorsmaster.currcode,
							  currencies.rate,
							  salesorders.fromstkloc,
							  custbranch.salesman
						FROM salesorders
						INNER JOIN debtorsmaster
						ON salesorders.debtorno = debtorsmaster.debtorno
						INNER JOIN custbranch
						ON salesorders.debtorno = custbranch.debtorno
						AND salesorders.branchcode = custbranch.branchcode
						INNER JOIN locations
						ON locations.loccode=salesorders.fromstkloc
						INNER JOIN currencies
						ON debtorsmaster.currcode=currencies.currabrev
						WHERE salesorders.orderno = '" . $OrderNo . "'";

	$OrderHeaderResult = api_DB_query($OrderHeaderSQL);
	if (DB_error_no() != 0) {
		$Errors[] = NoReadOrder;
	}

	$OrderHeader = DB_fetch_array($OrderHeaderResult);

	$TaxProvResult = api_DB_query("SELECT taxprovinceid FROM locations WHERE loccode='" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] ."'");
	if (DB_error_no() != 0) {
		$Errors[] = NoTaxProvince;
	}
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($TaxProvResult);
	$DispTaxProvinceID = $MyRow[0];

	$LineItemsSQL = "SELECT stkcode,
							unitprice,
							quantity,
							discountpercent,
							taxcatid,
							mbflag,
							actualcost AS standardcost
					FROM salesorderdetails INNER JOIN stockmaster
					ON salesorderdetails.stkcode = stockmaster.stockid
					WHERE orderno ='" . $OrderNo . "'
					AND completed=0";

	$LineItemsResult = api_DB_query($LineItemsSQL);
	if (DB_error_no() != 0 OR DB_num_rows($LineItemsResult)==0) {
		$Errors[] = NoReadOrderLines;
		return $Errors;
	}

/*Start an SQL transaction */
	DB_Txn_Begin();
/*Now Get the next invoice number - function in SQL_CommonFunctions */
	$InvoiceNo = GetNextTransNo(10);
	$PeriodNo = GetCurrentPeriod();

	$TaxTotals =array();

	$TotalFXNetInvoice = 0;
	$TotalFXTax = 0;
	$LineCounter =0;
	$LineTaxes = array();

	while ($OrderLineRow = DB_fetch_array($LineItemsResult)) {

		$StandardCost = $OrderLineRow['standardcost'];
		$LocalCurrencyPrice= ($OrderLineRow['unitprice'] *(1- floatval($OrderLineRow['discountpercent'])))/ $OrderHeader['rate'];
		$LineNetAmount = $OrderLineRow['unitprice'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity'] *(1- floatval($OrderLineRow['discountpercent']));

		/*Gets the Taxes and rates applicable to this line from the TaxGroup of the branch and TaxCategory of the item
		and the taxprovince of the dispatch location */

		$SQL = "SELECT taxgrouptaxes.calculationorder,
						taxauthorities.description,
						taxgrouptaxes.taxauthid,
						taxauthorities.taxglcode,
						taxgrouptaxes.taxontax,
						taxauthrates.taxrate
				FROM taxauthrates INNER JOIN taxgrouptaxes ON
					taxauthrates.taxauthority=taxgrouptaxes.taxauthid
					INNER JOIN taxauthorities ON
					taxauthrates.taxauthority=taxauthorities.taxid
				WHERE taxgrouptaxes.taxgroupid='" . $OrderHeader['taxgroupid'] . "'
				AND taxauthrates.dispatchtaxprovince='" . $DispTaxProvinceID . "'
				AND taxauthrates.taxcatid = '" . $OrderLineRow['taxcatid'] . "'
				ORDER BY taxgrouptaxes.calculationorder";

		$GetTaxRatesResult = api_DB_query($SQL);

		if (DB_error_no() != 0) {
			$Errors[] = TaxRatesFailed;
		}
		$LineTaxAmount = 0;
		$TaxAuthAmount = 0;
		while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($GetTaxRatesResult)){

			if (!isset($TaxTotals[$MyRow['taxauthid']]['FXAmount'])) {
				$TaxTotals[$MyRow['taxauthid']]['FXAmount']=0;
			}
			$TaxAuthID=$MyRow['taxauthid'];
			$TaxTotals[$MyRow['taxauthid']]['GLCode'] = $MyRow['taxglcode'];
			$TaxTotals[$MyRow['taxauthid']]['TaxRate'] = $MyRow['taxrate'];
			$TaxTotals[$MyRow['taxauthid']]['TaxAuthDescription'] = $MyRow['description'];

			if ($MyRow['taxontax'] ==1){
				$TaxAuthAmount = ($LineNetAmount+$LineTaxAmount) * $MyRow['taxrate'];
			} else {
				$TaxAuthAmount =  $LineNetAmount * $MyRow['taxrate'];
			}
			$TaxTotals[$MyRow['taxauthid']]['FXAmount'] += $TaxAuthAmount;

			/*Make an array of the taxes and amounts including GLcodes for later posting - need debtortransid
			so can only post once the debtor trans is posted - can only post debtor trans when all tax is calculated */
			$LineTaxes[$LineCounter][$MyRow['calculationorder']] = array('TaxCalculationOrder' =>$MyRow['calculationorder'],
											'TaxAuthID' =>$MyRow['taxauthid'],
											'TaxAuthDescription'=>$MyRow['description'],
											'TaxRate'=>$MyRow['taxrate'],
											'TaxOnTax'=>$MyRow['taxontax'],
											'TaxAuthAmount'=>$TaxAuthAmount);
			$LineTaxAmount += $TaxAuthAmount;

		}//end loop around Taxes

		$TotalFXNetInvoice += $LineNetAmount;
		$TotalFXTax += $LineTaxAmount;

		/*Now update SalesOrderDetails for the quantity invoiced and the actual dispatch dates. */
		$SQL = "UPDATE salesorderdetails
				SET qtyinvoiced = qtyinvoiced + " . $OrderLineRow['quantity'] . ",
					actualdispatchdate = '" . $OrderHeader['orddate'] .  "',
					completed='1'
				WHERE orderno = '" . $OrderNo . "'
				AND stkcode = '" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "'";

		$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);


		if ($OrderLineRow['mbflag']=='B' OR $OrderLineRow['mbflag']=='M') {
			$Assembly = false;

			/* Need to get the current location quantity
			will need it later for the stock movement */
			$SQL="SELECT locstock.quantity
					FROM locstock
					WHERE locstock.stockid='" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "'
					AND loccode= '" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] . "'";
			$Result = api_DB_query($SQL);

			if (DB_num_rows($Result)==1){
				$LocQtyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
				$QtyOnHandPrior = $LocQtyRow[0];
			} else {
				/* There must be some error this should never happen */
				$QtyOnHandPrior = 0;
			}

			$SQL = "UPDATE locstock
					SET quantity = locstock.quantity - " . $OrderLineRow['quantity'] . "
					WHERE locstock.stockid = '" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "'
					AND loccode = '" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] . "'";
			$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);

			$SQL = "INSERT INTO stockmoves (stockid,
											type,
											transno,
											loccode,
											trandate,
											debtorno,
											branchcode,
											price,
											prd,
											reference,
											qty,
											discountpercent,
											standardcost,
											newqoh)
					VALUES ('" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "',
							'10',
							'" . $InvoiceNo . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['orddate'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['branchcode'] . "',
							'" . $LocalCurrencyPrice . "',
							'" . $PeriodNo . "',
							'" . $OrderNo . "',
							'" . -$OrderLineRow['quantity'] . "',
							'" . $OrderLineRow['discountpercent'] . "',
							'" . $StandardCost . "',
							'" . ($QtyOnHandPrior - $OrderLineRow['quantity']) . "' )";

			$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);

		} elseif ($OrderLineRow['mbflag']=='A'){ /* its an assembly */
			/*Need to get the BOM for this part and make
			stock moves for the components then update the Location stock balances */
			$Assembly=true;
			$StandardCost =0; /*To start with - accumulate the cost of the comoponents for use in journals later on */
			$SQL = "SELECT bom.component,
							bom.quantity,
							stockmaster.actualcost AS standard
						FROM bom INNER JOIN stockmaster
						ON bom.component=stockmaster.stockid
						WHERE bom.parent='" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "'
						AND bom.effectiveafter <= CURRENT_DATE
						AND bom.effectiveto > CURRENT_DATE";

			$AssResult = api_DB_query($SQL);

			while ($AssParts = DB_fetch_array($AssResult)){

				$StandardCost += ($AssParts['standard'] * $AssParts['quantity']) ;
				/* Need to get the current location quantity
				will need it later for the stock movement */
				$SQL="SELECT locstock.quantity
						FROM locstock
						WHERE locstock.stockid='" . $AssParts['component'] . "'
						AND loccode= '" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] . "'";

				$Result = api_DB_query($SQL);
				if (DB_num_rows($Result)==1){
					$LocQtyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
					$QtyOnHandPrior = $LocQtyRow[0];
				} else {
					/*There must be some error this should never happen */
					$QtyOnHandPrior = 0;
				}
				if (empty($AssParts['standard'])) {
					$AssParts['standard']=0;
				}
				$SQL = "INSERT INTO stockmoves (stockid,
												type,
												transno,
												loccode,
												trandate,
												debtorno,
												branchcode,
												prd,
												reference,
												qty,
												standardcost,
												show_on_inv_crds,
												newqoh)
									VALUES ('" . $AssParts['component'] . "',
											 10,
											 '" . $InvoiceNo . "',
											 '" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] . "',
											 '" . $DefaultDispatchDate . "',
											 '" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "',
											 '" . $OrderHeader['branchcode'] . "',
											 '" . $PeriodNo . "',
											 '" . __('Assembly') . ': ' . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . ' ' . __('Order') . ': ' . $OrderNo . "',
											 '" . -$AssParts['quantity'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity'] . "',
											 '" . $AssParts['standard'] . "',
											 0,
											 '" . ($QtyOnHandPrior - $AssParts['quantity'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity']) . "'	)";

				$Result = DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);

				$SQL = "UPDATE locstock
						SET quantity = locstock.quantity - " . ($AssParts['quantity'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity']) . "
						WHERE locstock.stockid = '" . $AssParts['component'] . "'
						AND loccode = '" . $OrderHeader['fromlocstk'] . "'";

				$Result = DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);
			} /* end of assembly explosion and updates */
		} /* end of its an assembly */


		if ($OrderLineRow['mbflag']=='A' OR $OrderLineRow['mbflag']=='D'){
			/*it's a Dummy/Service item or an Assembly item - still need stock movement record
			 * but quantites on hand are always nil */
			$SQL = "INSERT INTO stockmoves (stockid,
											type,
											transno,
											loccode,
											trandate,
											debtorno,
											branchcode,
											price,
											prd,
											reference,
											qty,
											discountpercent,
											standardcost,
											newqoh)
					VALUES ('" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "',
							'10',
							'" . $InvoiceNo . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['orddate'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['branchcode'] . "',
							'" . $LocalCurrencyPrice . "',
							'" . $PeriodNo . "',
							'" . $OrderNo . "',
							'" . -$OrderLineRow['quantity'] . "',
							'" . $OrderLineRow['discountpercent'] . "',
							'" . $StandardCost . "',
							'0' )";

			$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);
		}
		/*Get the ID of the StockMove... */
		$StkMoveNo = DB_Last_Insert_ID('stockmoves','stkmoveno');
		/*Insert the taxes that applied to this line */
		foreach ($LineTaxes[$LineCounter] as $Tax) {

			$SQL = "INSERT INTO stockmovestaxes (stkmoveno,
								taxauthid,
								taxrate,
								taxcalculationorder,
								taxontax)
					VALUES ('" . $StkMoveNo . "',
						'" . $Tax['TaxAuthID'] . "',
						'" . $Tax['TaxRate'] . "',
						'" . $Tax['TaxCalculationOrder'] . "',
						'" . $Tax['TaxOnTax'] . "')";

			$Result = DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);
		}

		/*Insert Sales Analysis records */

		$SQL="SELECT COUNT(*),
					salesanalysis.stkcategory,
					salesanalysis.area,
					salesanalysis.salesperson,
					salesanalysis.periodno,
					salesanalysis.typeabbrev,
					salesanalysis.cust,
					salesanalysis.custbranch,
					salesanalysis.stockid
				FROM salesanalysis,
					custbranch,
					stockmaster
				WHERE salesanalysis.stkcategory=stockmaster.categoryid
				AND salesanalysis.stockid=stockmaster.stockid
				AND salesanalysis.cust=custbranch.debtorno

function GetCurrentPeriod () {

	$TransDate = time(); //The current date to find the period for
	/* Find the unix timestamp of the last period end date in periods table */
	$SQL = "SELECT MAX(lastdate_in_period), MAX(periodno) from periods";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL);
	$MyRow=DB_fetch_row($Result);

	if (is_null($MyRow[0])){
		$InsertFirstPeriodResult = api_DB_query("INSERT INTO periods VALUES (0,'" . Date('Y-m-d',mktime(0,0,0,Date('m')+1,0,Date('Y'))) . "')");
		$InsertFirstPeriodResult = api_DB_query("INSERT INTO periods VALUES (1,'" . Date('Y-m-d',mktime(0,0,0,Date('m')+2,0,Date('Y'))) . "')");
		$LastPeriod=1;
		$LastPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,Date('m')+2,0,Date('Y'));
	} else {
		$Date_Array = explode('-', $MyRow[0]);
		$LastPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,$Date_Array[1]+1,0,(int)$Date_Array[0]);
		$LastPeriod = $MyRow[1];
	}
	/* Find the unix timestamp of the first period end date in periods table */
	$SQL = "SELECT MIN(lastdate_in_period), MIN(periodno) from periods";
	$Result = api_DB_query($SQL);
	$MyRow=DB_fetch_row($Result);
	$Date_Array = explode('-', $MyRow[0]);
	$FirstPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,$Date_Array[1],0,(int)$Date_Array[0]);
	$FirstPeriod = $MyRow[1];

	/* If the period number doesn't exist */
	if (!PeriodExists($TransDate)) {
		/* if the transaction is after the last period */
		if ($TransDate > $LastPeriodEnd) {

			$PeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,Date('m', $TransDate)+1, 0, Date('Y', $TransDate));

			while ($PeriodEnd >= $LastPeriodEnd) {
				if (Date('m', $LastPeriodEnd)<=13) {
					$LastPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,Date('m', $LastPeriodEnd)+2, 0, Date('Y', $LastPeriodEnd));
				} else {
					$LastPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,2, 0, Date('Y', $LastPeriodEnd)+1);
				}
				$LastPeriod++;
				CreatePeriod($LastPeriod, $LastPeriodEnd);
			}
		} else {
		/* The transaction is before the first period */
			$PeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,Date('m', $TransDate), 0, Date('Y', $TransDate));
			$Period = $FirstPeriod - 1;
			while ($FirstPeriodEnd > $PeriodEnd) {
				CreatePeriod($Period, $FirstPeriodEnd);
				$Period--;
				if (Date('m', $FirstPeriodEnd)>0) {
					$FirstPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,Date('m', $FirstPeriodEnd), 0, Date('Y', $FirstPeriodEnd));
				} else {
					$FirstPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,13, 0, Date('Y', $FirstPeriodEnd));
				}
			}
		}
	} elseif (!PeriodExists(mktime(0,0,0,Date('m',$TransDate)+1,Date('d',$TransDate),Date('Y',$TransDate)))) {
		/* Make sure the following months period exists */
		$SQL = "SELECT MAX(lastdate_in_period), MAX(periodno) from periods";
		$Result = DB_query($SQL);
		$MyRow=DB_fetch_row($Result);
		$Date_Array = explode('-', $MyRow[0]);
		$LastPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,$Date_Array[1]+2,0,(int)$Date_Array[0]);
		$LastPeriod = $MyRow[1];
		CreatePeriod($LastPeriod+1, $LastPeriodEnd);
	}

	/* Now return the period number of the transaction */

	$MonthAfterTransDate = Mktime(0,0,0,Date('m',$TransDate)+1,Date('d',$TransDate),Date('Y',$TransDate));
	$GetPrdSQL = "SELECT periodno
					FROM periods
					WHERE lastdate_in_period < '" . Date('Y-m-d', $MonthAfterTransDate) . "'
					AND lastdate_in_period >= '" . Date('Y-m-d', $TransDate) . "'";

	$ErrMsg = __('An error occurred in retrieving the period number');
	$GetPrdResult = DB_query($GetPrdSQL, $ErrMsg);
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($GetPrdResult);

	return $MyRow[0];
}

function InvoiceSalesOrder($OrderNo, $User, $Password) {

	$Errors = array();
	$db = db($User, $Password);
	if (gettype($db)=='integer') {
		$Errors[]=NoAuthorisation;
		return $Errors;
	}
	$Errors=VerifyOrderHeaderExists($OrderNo, sizeof($Errors), $Errors);
	if (sizeof($Errors)!=0) {
		return $Errors;
	}
	/*Credit control - a customer on stop, or an order held for the credit limit, is not invoiced unless credit control released the order.
	An order that has not been checked yet is checked against the credit limit now and held if it is over */
	$CreditOrder = DB_fetch_array(api_DB_query("SELECT debtorno, creditheld FROM salesorders WHERE orderno='" . $OrderNo . "'"));
	if (CCDispatchBlockReason($OrderNo) != '') {
		$Errors[] = (GetCreditStatus($CreditOrder['debtorno'])['status'] == 'stop') ? CustomerOnStop : OrderHeldForCreditControl;
		return $Errors;
	}
	if ($CreditOrder['creditheld'] == 0) {
		$CreditCheck = CCOrderCheck($CreditOrder['debtorno'], CCOrderValue($OrderNo), $OrderNo);
		if ($CreditCheck['hold']) {
			api_DB_query("UPDATE salesorders SET creditheld = 1 WHERE orderno='" . $OrderNo . "'");
			$Errors[] = OrderHeldForCreditControl;
			return $Errors;
		}
	}
	/*Does not deal with assembly items or serialise/lot track items - for use by POS */
	/*Get Company Defaults */
	$ReadCoyResult = api_DB_query("SELECT debtorsact,
											freightact,
											gllink_debtors,
											gllink_stock
									FROM companies
									WHERE coycode=1");

	$CompanyRecord = DB_fetch_array($ReadCoyResult);
	if (DB_error_no() != 0) {
		$Errors[] = NoCompanyRecord;
	}

	$OrderHeaderSQL = "SELECT salesorders.debtorno,
							  debtorsmaster.name,
							  salesorders.branchcode,
							  salesorders.customerref,
							  salesorders.orddate,
							  salesorders.ordertype,
							  salesorders.shipvia,
							  custbranch.area,
							  custbranch.taxgroupid,
							  debtorsmaster.currcode,
							  currencies.rate,
							  salesorders.fromstkloc,
							  custbranch.salesman
						FROM salesorders
						INNER JOIN debtorsmaster
						ON salesorders.debtorno = debtorsmaster.debtorno
						INNER JOIN custbranch
						ON salesorders.debtorno = custbranch.debtorno
						AND salesorders.branchcode = custbranch.branchcode
						INNER JOIN locations
						ON locations.loccode=salesorders.fromstkloc
						INNER JOIN currencies
						ON debtorsmaster.currcode=currencies.currabrev
						WHERE salesorders.orderno = '" . $OrderNo . "'";

	$OrderHeaderResult = api_DB_query($OrderHeaderSQL);
	if (DB_error_no() != 0) {
		$Errors[] = NoReadOrder;
	}

	$OrderHeader = DB_fetch_array($OrderHeaderResult);

	$TaxProvResult = api_DB_query("SELECT taxprovinceid FROM locations WHERE loccode='" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] ."'");
	if (DB_error_no() != 0) {
		$Errors[] = NoTaxProvince;
	}
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($TaxProvResult);
	$DispTaxProvinceID = $MyRow[0];

	$LineItemsSQL = "SELECT stkcode,
							unitprice,
							quantity,
							discountpercent,
							taxcatid,
							mbflag,
							actualcost AS standardcost
					FROM salesorderdetails INNER JOIN stockmaster
					ON salesorderdetails.stkcode = stockmaster.stockid
					WHERE orderno ='" . $OrderNo . "'
					AND completed=0";

	$LineItemsResult = api_DB_query($LineItemsSQL);
	if (DB_error_no() != 0 OR DB_num_rows($LineItemsResult)==0) {
		$Errors[] = NoReadOrderLines;
		return $Errors;
	}

/*Start an SQL transaction */
	DB_Txn_Begin();
/*Now Get the next invoice number - function in SQL_CommonFunctions */
	$InvoiceNo = GetNextTransNo(10);
	$PeriodNo = GetCurrentPeriod();

	$TaxTotals =array();

	$TotalFXNetInvoice = 0;
	$TotalFXTax = 0;
	$LineCounter =0;
	$LineTaxes = array();

	while ($OrderLineRow = DB_fetch_array($LineItemsResult)) {

		$StandardCost = $OrderLineRow['standardcost'];
		$LocalCurrencyPrice= ($OrderLineRow['unitprice'] *(1- floatval($OrderLineRow['discountpercent'])))/ $OrderHeader['rate'];
		$LineNetAmount = $OrderLineRow['unitprice'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity'] *(1- floatval($OrderLineRow['discountpercent']));

		/*Gets the Taxes and rates applicable to this line from the TaxGroup of the branch and TaxCategory of the item
		and the taxprovince of the dispatch location */

		$SQL = "SELECT taxgrouptaxes.calculationorder,
						taxauthorities.description,
						taxgrouptaxes.taxauthid,
						taxauthorities.taxglcode,
						taxgrouptaxes.taxontax,
						taxauthrates.taxrate
				FROM taxauthrates INNER JOIN taxgrouptaxes ON
					taxauthrates.taxauthority=taxgrouptaxes.taxauthid
					INNER JOIN taxauthorities ON
					taxauthrates.taxauthority=taxauthorities.taxid
				WHERE taxgrouptaxes.taxgroupid='" . $OrderHeader['taxgroupid'] . "'
				AND taxauthrates.dispatchtaxprovince='" . $DispTaxProvinceID . "'
				AND taxauthrates.taxcatid = '" . $OrderLineRow['taxcatid'] . "'
				ORDER BY taxgrouptaxes.calculationorder";

		$GetTaxRatesResult = api_DB_query($SQL);

		if (DB_error_no() != 0) {
			$Errors[] = TaxRatesFailed;
		}
		$LineTaxAmount = 0;
		$TaxAuthAmount = 0;
		while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($GetTaxRatesResult)){

			if (!isset($TaxTotals[$MyRow['taxauthid']]['FXAmount'])) {
				$TaxTotals[$MyRow['taxauthid']]['FXAmount']=0;
			}
			$TaxAuthID=$MyRow['taxauthid'];
			$TaxTotals[$MyRow['taxauthid']]['GLCode'] = $MyRow['taxglcode'];
			$TaxTotals[$MyRow['taxauthid']]['TaxRate'] = $MyRow['taxrate'];
			$TaxTotals[$MyRow['taxauthid']]['TaxAuthDescription'] = $MyRow['description'];

			if ($MyRow['taxontax'] ==1){
				$TaxAuthAmount = ($LineNetAmount+$LineTaxAmount) * $MyRow['taxrate'];
			} else {
				$TaxAuthAmount =  $LineNetAmount * $MyRow['taxrate'];
			}
			$TaxTotals[$MyRow['taxauthid']]['FXAmount'] += $TaxAuthAmount;

			/*Make an array of the taxes and amounts including GLcodes for later posting - need debtortransid
			so can only post once the debtor trans is posted - can only post debtor trans when all tax is calculated */
			$LineTaxes[$LineCounter][$MyRow['calculationorder']] = array('TaxCalculationOrder' =>$MyRow['calculationorder'],
											'TaxAuthID' =>$MyRow['taxauthid'],
											'TaxAuthDescription'=>$MyRow['description'],
											'TaxRate'=>$MyRow['taxrate'],
											'TaxOnTax'=>$MyRow['taxontax'],
											'TaxAuthAmount'=>$TaxAuthAmount);
			$LineTaxAmount += $TaxAuthAmount;

		}//end loop around Taxes

		$TotalFXNetInvoice += $LineNetAmount;
		$TotalFXTax += $LineTaxAmount;

		/*Now update SalesOrderDetails for the quantity invoiced and the actual dispatch dates. */
		$SQL = "UPDATE salesorderdetails
				SET qtyinvoiced = qtyinvoiced + " . $OrderLineRow['quantity'] . ",
					actualdispatchdate = '" . $OrderHeader['orddate'] .  "',
					completed='1'
				WHERE orderno = '" . $OrderNo . "'
				AND stkcode = '" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "'";

		$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);


		if ($OrderLineRow['mbflag']=='B' OR $OrderLineRow['mbflag']=='M') {
			$Assembly = false;

			/* Need to get the current location quantity
			will need it later for the stock movement */
			$SQL="SELECT locstock.quantity
					FROM locstock
					WHERE locstock.stockid='" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "'
					AND loccode= '" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] . "'";
			$Result = api_DB_query($SQL);

			if (DB_num_rows($Result)==1){
				$LocQtyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
				$QtyOnHandPrior = $LocQtyRow[0];
			} else {
				/* There must be some error this should never happen */
				$QtyOnHandPrior = 0;
			}

			$SQL = "UPDATE locstock
					SET quantity = locstock.quantity - " . $OrderLineRow['quantity'] . "
					WHERE locstock.stockid = '" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "'
					AND loccode = '" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] . "'";
			$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);

			$SQL = "INSERT INTO stockmoves (stockid,
											type,
											transno,
											loccode,
											trandate,
											debtorno,
											branchcode,
											price,
											prd,
											reference,
											qty,
											discountpercent,
											standardcost,
											newqoh)
					VALUES ('" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "',
							'10',
							'" . $InvoiceNo . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['orddate'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['branchcode'] . "',
							'" . $LocalCurrencyPrice . "',
							'" . $PeriodNo . "',
							'" . $OrderNo . "',
							'" . -$OrderLineRow['quantity'] . "',
							'" . $OrderLineRow['discountpercent'] . "',
							'" . $StandardCost . "',
							'" . ($QtyOnHandPrior - $OrderLineRow['quantity']) . "' )";

			$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);

		} elseif ($OrderLineRow['mbflag']=='A'){ /* its an assembly */
			/*Need to get the BOM for this part and make
			stock moves for the components then update the Location stock balances */
			$Assembly=true;
			$StandardCost =0; /*To start with - accumulate the cost of the comoponents for use in journals later on */
			$SQL = "SELECT bom.component,
							bom.quantity,
							stockmaster.actualcost AS standard
						FROM bom INNER JOIN stockmaster
						ON bom.component=stockmaster.stockid
						WHERE bom.parent='" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "'
						AND bom.effectiveafter <= CURRENT_DATE
						AND bom.effectiveto > CURRENT_DATE";

			$AssResult = api_DB_query($SQL);

			while ($AssParts = DB_fetch_array($AssResult)){

				$StandardCost += ($AssParts['standard'] * $AssParts['quantity']) ;
				/* Need to get the current location quantity
				will need it later for the stock movement */
				$SQL="SELECT locstock.quantity
						FROM locstock
						WHERE locstock.stockid='" . $AssParts['component'] . "'
						AND loccode= '" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] . "'";

				$Result = api_DB_query($SQL);
				if (DB_num_rows($Result)==1){
					$LocQtyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
					$QtyOnHandPrior = $LocQtyRow[0];
				} else {
					/*There must be some error this should never happen */
					$QtyOnHandPrior = 0;
				}
				if (empty($AssParts['standard'])) {
					$AssParts['standard']=0;
				}
				$SQL = "INSERT INTO stockmoves (stockid,
												type,
												transno,
												loccode,
												trandate,
												debtorno,
												branchcode,
												prd,
												reference,
												qty,
												standardcost,
												show_on_inv_crds,
												newqoh)
									VALUES ('" . $AssParts['component'] . "',
											 10,
											 '" . $InvoiceNo . "',
											 '" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] . "',
											 '" . $DefaultDispatchDate . "',
											 '" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "',
											 '" . $OrderHeader['branchcode'] . "',
											 '" . $PeriodNo . "',
											 '" . __('Assembly') . ': ' . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . ' ' . __('Order') . ': ' . $OrderNo . "',
											 '" . -$AssParts['quantity'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity'] . "',
											 '" . $AssParts['standard'] . "',
											 0,
											 '" . ($QtyOnHandPrior - $AssParts['quantity'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity']) . "'	)";

				$Result = DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);

				$SQL = "UPDATE locstock
						SET quantity = locstock.quantity - " . ($AssParts['quantity'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity']) . "
						WHERE locstock.stockid = '" . $AssParts['component'] . "'
						AND loccode = '" . $OrderHeader['fromlocstk'] . "'";

				$Result = DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);
			} /* end of assembly explosion and updates */
		} /* end of its an assembly */


		if ($OrderLineRow['mbflag']=='A' OR $OrderLineRow['mbflag']=='D'){
			/*it's a Dummy/Service item or an Assembly item - still need stock movement record
			 * but quantites on hand are always nil */
			$SQL = "INSERT INTO stockmoves (stockid,
											type,
											transno,
											loccode,
											trandate,
											debtorno,
											branchcode,
											price,
											prd,
											reference,
											qty,
											discountpercent,
											standardcost,
											newqoh)
					VALUES ('" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "',
							'10',
							'" . $InvoiceNo . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['fromstkloc'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['orddate'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['branchcode'] . "',
							'" . $LocalCurrencyPrice . "',
							'" . $PeriodNo . "',
							'" . $OrderNo . "',
							'" . -$OrderLineRow['quantity'] . "',
							'" . $OrderLineRow['discountpercent'] . "',
							'" . $StandardCost . "',
							'0' )";

			$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);
		}
		/*Get the ID of the StockMove... */
		$StkMoveNo = DB_Last_Insert_ID('stockmoves','stkmoveno');
		/*Insert the taxes that applied to this line */
		foreach ($LineTaxes[$LineCounter] as $Tax) {

			$SQL = "INSERT INTO stockmovestaxes (stkmoveno,
								taxauthid,
								taxrate,
								taxcalculationorder,
								taxontax)
					VALUES ('" . $StkMoveNo . "',
						'" . $Tax['TaxAuthID'] . "',
						'" . $Tax['TaxRate'] . "',
						'" . $Tax['TaxCalculationOrder'] . "',
						'" . $Tax['TaxOnTax'] . "')";

			$Result = DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);
		}

		/*Insert Sales Analysis records */

		$SQL="SELECT COUNT(*),
					salesanalysis.stkcategory,
					salesanalysis.area,
					salesanalysis.salesperson,
					salesanalysis.periodno,
					salesanalysis.typeabbrev,
					salesanalysis.cust,
					salesanalysis.custbranch,
					salesanalysis.stockid
				FROM salesanalysis,
					custbranch,
					stockmaster
				WHERE salesanalysis.stkcategory=stockmaster.categoryid
				AND salesanalysis.stockid=stockmaster.stockid
				AND salesanalysis.cust=custbranch.debtorno
				AND salesanalysis.custbranch=custbranch.branchcode
				AND salesanalysis.area=custbranch.area
				AND salesanalysis.salesperson=custbranch.salesman
				AND salesanalysis.typeabbrev ='" . $OrderHeader['ordertype'] . "'
				AND salesanalysis.periodno='" . $PeriodNo . "'
				AND salesanalysis.cust " . LIKE . "  '" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "'
				AND salesanalysis.custbranch  " . LIKE . " '" . $OrderHeader['branchcode'] . "'
				AND salesanalysis.stockid  " . LIKE . " '" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "'
				AND salesanalysis.budgetoractual='1'
				GROUP BY salesanalysis.stockid,
					salesanalysis.stkcategory,
					salesanalysis.cust,
					salesanalysis.custbranch,
					salesanalysis.area,
					salesanalysis.periodno,
					salesanalysis.typeabbrev,
					salesanalysis.salesperson";

		$ErrMsg = __('The count of existing Sales analysis records could not run because');
		$Result = DB_query($SQL, $ErrMsg, '', true);

		$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);

		if ($MyRow[0]>0){  /*Update the existing record that already exists */

			$SQL = "UPDATE salesanalysis
					SET amt=amt+" . filter_number_format($OrderLineRow['unitprice'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity'] / $OrderHeader['rate']) . ",
					qty=qty +" . $OrderLineRow['quantity'] . ",
					disc=disc+" . filter_number_format($OrderLineRow['discountpercent'] * $OrderLineRow['unitprice'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity'] / $OrderHeader['rate']) . "
					WHERE salesanalysis.area='" . $MyRow[2] . "'
					AND salesanalysis.salesperson='" . $MyRow[3] . "'
					AND typeabbrev ='" . $OrderHeader['ordertype'] . "'
					AND periodno = '" . $PeriodNo . "'
					AND cust  " . LIKE . " '" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "'
					AND custbranch  " . LIKE . "  '" . $OrderHeader['branchcode'] . "'
					AND stockid  " . LIKE . " '" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "'
					AND salesanalysis.stkcategory ='" . $MyRow[1] . "'
					AND budgetoractual='1'";

		} else { /* insert a new sales analysis record */

			$SQL = "INSERT INTO salesanalysis (	typeabbrev,
												periodno,
												amt,
												cost,
												cust,
												custbranch,
												qty,
												disc,
												stockid,
												area,
												budgetoractual,
												salesperson,
												stkcategory )
							SELECT '" . $OrderHeader['ordertype']. "',
								'" . $PeriodNo . "',
								'" . $OrderLineRow['unitprice'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity'] / $OrderHeader['rate'] . "',
								0,
								'" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "',
								'" . $OrderHeader['branchcode'] . "',
								'" . $OrderLineRow['quantity'] . "',
								'" . $OrderLineRow['discountpercent'] * $OrderLineRow['unitprice'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity'] / $OrderHeader['rate'] . "',
								'" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "',
								custbranch.area,
								1,
								custbranch.salesman,
								stockmaster.categoryid
							FROM stockmaster, custbranch
							WHERE stockmaster.stockid = '" . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . "'
							AND custbranch.debtorno = '" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "'
							AND custbranch.branchcode='" . $OrderHeader['branchcode'] . "'";

		}

		$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);

		if ($CompanyRecord['gllink_stock']==1 AND $StandardCost !=0){

/*first the cost of sales entry - GL accounts are retrieved using the function GetCOGSGLAccount from includes/GetSalesTransGLCodes.php  */

			$SQL = "INSERT INTO gltrans (type,
										typeno,
										trandate,
										periodno,
										account,
										narrative,
										amount)
								VALUES (10,
									'" . $InvoiceNo . "',
									'" . $OrderHeader['orddate'] . "',
									'" . $PeriodNo . "',
									'" . GetCOGSGLAccount($OrderHeader['area'], $OrderLineRow['stkcode'], $OrderHeader['ordertype']) . "',
									'" . mb_substr($OrderHeader['debtorno'] . " - " . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . " x " . $OrderLineRow['quantity'] . " @ " . $StandardCost, 0, 200) . "',
									'" . ($StandardCost * $OrderLineRow['quantity']) . "')";

			$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);

/*now the stock entry - this is set to the cost act in the case of a fixed asset disposal */
			$StockGLCode = GetStockGLCode($OrderLineRow['stkcode']);

			$SQL = "INSERT INTO gltrans (type,
										typeno,
										trandate,
										periodno,
										account,
										narrative,
										amount)
								VALUES (10,
									'" . $InvoiceNo . "',
									'" . $OrderHeader['orddate'] . "',
									'" . $PeriodNo . "',
									'" . $StockGLCode['stockact'] . "',
									'" . mb_substr($OrderHeader['debtorno'] . " - " . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . " x " . $OrderLineRow['quantity'] . " @ " . $StandardCost, 0, 200) . "',
									'" . (-$StandardCost * $OrderLineRow['quantity']) . "')";

			$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);

		} /* end of if GL and stock integrated and standard cost !=0  and not an asset */

		if ($CompanyRecord['gllink_debtors']==1 AND $OrderLineRow['unitprice'] !=0){

			//Post sales transaction to GL credit sales
			$SalesGLAccounts = GetSalesGLAccount($OrderHeader['area'], $OrderLineRow['stkcode'], $OrderHeader['ordertype']);

			$SQL = "INSERT INTO gltrans (type,
										typeno,
										trandate,
										periodno,
										account,
										narrative,
										amount )
				VALUES ('10',
					'" . $InvoiceNo . "',
					'" . $OrderHeader['orddate'] . "',
					'" . $PeriodNo . "',
					'" . $SalesGLAccounts['salesglcode'] . "',
					'" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . " - " . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . " x " . $OrderLineRow['quantity'] . " @ " . $OrderLineRow['unitprice'] . "',
					'" . -$OrderLineRow['unitprice'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity']/$OrderHeader['rate'] . "'
				)";
			$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);

			if ($OrderLineRow['discountpercent'] !=0){

				$SQL = "INSERT INTO gltrans (type,
											typeno,
											trandate,
											periodno,
											account,
											narrative,
											amount)
						VALUES (10,
							'" . $InvoiceNo . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['orddate'] . "',
							'" . $PeriodNo . "',
							'" . $SalesGLAccounts['discountglcode'] . "',
							'" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . " - " . $OrderLineRow['stkcode'] . " @ " . ($OrderLineRow['discountpercent'] * 100) . "%',
							'" . ($OrderLineRow['unitprice'] * $OrderLineRow['quantity'] * $OrderLineRow['discountpercent']/$OrderHeader['rate']) . "')";

				$Result = DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);
			} /*end of if discount !=0 */

		} /*end of if sales integrated with gl */

		$LineCounter++; //needed for the array of taxes by line
	} /*end of OrderLine loop */

	$TotalInvLocalCurr = ($TotalFXNetInvoice + $TotalFXTax)/$OrderHeader['rate'];

	if ($CompanyRecord['gllink_debtors']==1){

		/*Now post the tax to the GL at local currency equivalent */
		if ($CompanyRecord['gllink_debtors']==1 AND $TaxAuthAmount !=0) {

			/*Loop through the tax authorities array to post each total to the taxauth glcode */
			foreach ($TaxTotals as $Tax){
				$SQL = "INSERT INTO gltrans (type,
											typeno,
											trandate,
											periodno,
											account,
											narrative,
											amount )
										VALUES (10,
										'" . $InvoiceNo . "',
										'" . $OrderHeader['orddate']. "',
										'" . $PeriodNo . "',
										'" . $Tax['GLCode'] . "',
										'" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "-" . $Tax['TaxAuthDescription'] . "',
										'" . -$Tax['FXAmount']/$OrderHeader['rate'] . "' )";

				$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);
			}
		}

		/*Post debtors transaction to GL debit debtors, credit freight re-charged and credit sales */
		if (($TotalInvLocalCurr) !=0) {
			$SQL = "INSERT INTO gltrans (type,
										typeno,
										trandate,
										periodno,
										account,
										narrative,
										amount)
								VALUES ('10',

									'" . $OrderHeader['orddate'] . "',
									'" . $PeriodNo . "',
									'" . $CompanyRecord['debtorsact'] . "',
									'" . $OrderHeader['debtorno'] . "',
									'" . $TotalInvLocalCurr . "')";

			$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);
		}
		EnsureGLEntriesBalance(10,$InvoiceNo);

	} /*end of if Sales and GL integrated */

/*Update order header for invoice charged on */
	$SQL = "UPDATE salesorders SET comments = CONCAT(comments,' Inv ','" . $InvoiceNo . "') WHERE orderno= '" . $OrderNo . "'";
	$Result = api_DB_query($SQL,'', '', true);

/*Now insert the DebtorTrans */

	$SQL = "INSERT INTO debtortrans (transno,

									debtorno,
									branchcode,
									trandate,
									inputdate,
									prd,
									reference,

									ovgst,
									rate,

	return $Errors;
} //end InvoiceSalesOrder function


function GetCurrentPeriod () {

	$TransDate = time(); //The current date to find the period for
	/* Find the unix timestamp of the last period end date in periods table */
	$SQL = "SELECT MAX(lastdate_in_period), MAX(periodno) from periods";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL);
	$MyRow=DB_fetch_row($Result);

	if (is_null($MyRow[0])){
		$InsertFirstPeriodResult = api_DB_query("INSERT INTO periods VALUES (0,'" . Date('Y-m-d',mktime(0,0,0,Date('m')+1,0,Date('Y'))) . "')");
		$InsertFirstPeriodResult = api_DB_query("INSERT INTO periods VALUES (1,'" . Date('Y-m-d',mktime(0,0,0,Date('m')+2,0,Date('Y'))) . "')");
		$LastPeriod=1;
		$LastPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,Date('m')+2,0,Date('Y'));
	} else {
		$Date_Array = explode('-', $MyRow[0]);
		$LastPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,$Date_Array[1]+1,0,(int)$Date_Array[0]);
		$LastPeriod = $MyRow[1];
	}
	/* Find the unix timestamp of the first period end date in periods table */
	$SQL = "SELECT MIN(lastdate_in_period), MIN(periodno) from periods";
	$Result = api_DB_query($SQL);
	$MyRow=DB_fetch_row($Result);
	$Date_Array = explode('-', $MyRow[0]);
	$FirstPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,$Date_Array[1],0,(int)$Date_Array[0]);
	$FirstPeriod = $MyRow[1];

	/* If the period number doesn't exist */
	if (!PeriodExists($TransDate)) {
		/* if the transaction is after the last period */
		if ($TransDate > $LastPeriodEnd) {

			$PeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,Date('m', $TransDate)+1, 0, Date('Y', $TransDate));

			while ($PeriodEnd >= $LastPeriodEnd) {
				if (Date('m', $LastPeriodEnd)<=13) {
					$LastPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,Date('m', $LastPeriodEnd)+2, 0, Date('Y', $LastPeriodEnd));
				} else {
					$LastPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,2, 0, Date('Y', $LastPeriodEnd)+1);
				}
				$LastPeriod++;
				CreatePeriod($LastPeriod, $LastPeriodEnd);
			}
		} else {
		/* The transaction is before the first period */
			$PeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,Date('m', $TransDate), 0, Date('Y', $TransDate));
			$Period = $FirstPeriod - 1;
			while ($FirstPeriodEnd > $PeriodEnd) {
				CreatePeriod($Period, $FirstPeriodEnd);
				$Period--;
				if (Date('m', $FirstPeriodEnd)>0) {
					$FirstPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,Date('m', $FirstPeriodEnd), 0, Date('Y', $FirstPeriodEnd));
				} else {
					$FirstPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,13, 0, Date('Y', $FirstPeriodEnd));
				}
			}
		}
	} elseif (!PeriodExists(mktime(0,0,0,Date('m',$TransDate)+1,Date('d',$TransDate),Date('Y',$TransDate)))) {
		/* Make sure the following months period exists */
		$SQL = "SELECT MAX(lastdate_in_period), MAX(periodno) from periods";
		$Result = DB_query($SQL);
		$MyRow=DB_fetch_row($Result);
		$Date_Array = explode('-', $MyRow[0]);
		$LastPeriodEnd = mktime(0,0,0,$Date_Array[1]+2,0,(int)$Date_Array[0]);
		$LastPeriod = $MyRow[1];
		CreatePeriod($LastPeriod+1, $LastPeriodEnd);
	}

	/* Now return the period number of the transaction */

	$MonthAfterTransDate = Mktime(0,0,0,Date('m',$TransDate)+1,Date('d',$TransDate),Date('Y',$TransDate));
	$GetPrdSQL = "SELECT periodno
					FROM periods
					WHERE lastdate_in_period < '" . Date('Y-m-d', $MonthAfterTransDate) . "'
					AND lastdate_in_period >= '" . Date('Y-m-d', $TransDate) . "'";

	$ErrMsg = __('An error occurred in retrieving the period number');
	$GetPrdResult = DB_query($GetPrdSQL, $ErrMsg);
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($GetPrdResult);

	return $MyRow[0];
}

<?php

/* Credit control shared functions.

Credit status is not stored in a column of its own. A customer's status comes from the hold reason on debtorsmaster, the
way the rest of webERP already reads it:
	holdreasons.dissallowinvoices = 1  customer is on stop
	holdreasons.dissallowinvoices = 2  customer is on watch
	anything else                      normal

Everything that changes credit control state writes a row to creditcontrollog so the history per customer can be audited.
*/

function CCSetting($Name, $Default = '') {
	return isset($_SESSION[$Name]) ? $_SESSION[$Name] : $Default;
}

/* Credit controller, deputy and Finance Director hold the credit control token. The token is the one the script table gives CreditControl.php */
function CCIsCreditController() {
	return isset($_SESSION['PageSecurityArray']['CreditControl.php'])
		AND in_array($_SESSION['PageSecurityArray']['CreditControl.php'], $_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']);
}

/* Only the Finance Director approves large write-offs - token 22 */
function CCIsFinanceDirector() {
	return in_array(22, $_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']);
}

function CCStatusName($Status) {
	if ($Status == 'stop') {
		return __('On stop');
	} elseif ($Status == 'watch') {
		return __('On watch');
	}
	return __('Normal');
}

function CCStatusFromHoldFlag($DissallowInvoices) {
	if ($DissallowInvoices == 1) {
		return 'stop';
	} elseif ($DissallowInvoices == 2) {
		return 'watch';
	}
	return 'normal';
}

function CCWriteLog($DebtorNo, $Action, $Detail, $Amount = 0, $TransType = 0, $TransNo = 0) {
	/* the history is append only - nothing in webERP updates or deletes creditcontrollog rows */
	$SQL = "INSERT INTO creditcontrollog (debtorno,
										logdate,
										userid,
										action,
										detail,
										amount,
										transtype,
										transno)
					VALUES ('" . $DebtorNo . "',
							'" . date('Y-m-d H:i:s') . "',
							'" . $_SESSION['UserID'] . "',
							'" . $Action . "',
							'" . DB_escape_string($Detail) . "',
							'" . $Amount . "',
							'" . $TransType . "',
							'" . $TransNo . "')";
	DB_query($SQL, __('The credit control history could not be recorded because'));
}

/* Returns the credit status and the numbers a credit controller looks at, false if the customer does not exist */
function GetCreditStatus($DebtorNo) {
	$SQL = "SELECT debtorsmaster.debtorno,
					debtorsmaster.name,
					debtorsmaster.currcode,
					debtorsmaster.creditlimit,
					debtorsmaster.holdreason,
					debtorsmaster.nextreviewdate,
					debtorsmaster.reviewmonths,
					debtorsmaster.exemptinterest,
					debtorsmaster.exemptfees,
					holdreasons.reasondescription,
					holdreasons.dissallowinvoices,
					currencies.rate,
					currencies.decimalplaces
				FROM debtorsmaster
				INNER JOIN holdreasons
					ON debtorsmaster.holdreason = holdreasons.reasoncode
				INNER JOIN currencies
					ON debtorsmaster.currcode = currencies.currabrev
				WHERE debtorsmaster.debtorno = '" . $DebtorNo . "'";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL);
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return false;
	}
	$Row = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	$Row['status'] = CCStatusFromHoldFlag($Row['dissallowinvoices']);
	$BalanceResult = DB_query("SELECT SUM(balance) AS balance FROM debtortrans WHERE debtorno='" . $DebtorNo . "'");
	$BalanceRow = DB_fetch_array($BalanceResult);
	$Row['balance'] = $BalanceRow['balance'] == '' ? 0 : $BalanceRow['balance'];
	return $Row;
}

/* Credit available to a customer. The same arithmetic as GetCreditAvailable() but it can leave one order out, so an order that is being
changed is not counted against itself */
function CCCreditAvailable($DebtorNo, $ExcludeOrderNo = 0) {
	$SQL = "SELECT creditlimit FROM debtorsmaster WHERE debtorno='" . $DebtorNo . "'";
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array(DB_query($SQL));
	$Available = $MyRow['creditlimit'];
	$SQL = "SELECT SUM(balance) AS balance FROM debtortrans WHERE debtorno='" . $DebtorNo . "'";
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array(DB_query($SQL));
	$Available -= $MyRow['balance'];
	$SQL = "SELECT SUM(salesorderdetails.unitprice *
					(salesorderdetails.quantity - salesorderdetails.qtyinvoiced) *
					(1 - salesorderdetails.discountpercent)) AS ordervalue
			FROM salesorders
			INNER JOIN salesorderdetails
				ON salesorders.orderno = salesorderdetails.orderno
			WHERE salesorders.debtorno = '" . $DebtorNo . "'
				AND salesorderdetails.completed = 0
				AND salesorders.quotation = 0
				AND salesorders.orderno <> '" . (int)$ExcludeOrderNo . "'";
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array(DB_query($SQL));
	$Available -= $MyRow['ordervalue'];
	return $Available;
}

/* The one question every order route asks before it accepts an order: can this customer be supplied?

Returns an array: status (normal, watch, stop), reason (hold reason text), overlimit (true when the order takes the customer over their limit),
available (credit left before this order) and hold (true when the order must be held for credit control approval).
Stop is a refusal whatever the value. Over limit is a hold, unless CCHoldOverLimitOrders is switched off. */
function CCOrderCheck($DebtorNo, $OrderValue = 0, $ExcludeOrderNo = 0) {
	$Info = GetCreditStatus($DebtorNo);
	$Check = array('status' => 'normal', 'reason' => '', 'overlimit' => false, 'available' => 0, 'hold' => false);
	if ($Info === false) {
		return $Check;
	}
	$Check['status'] = $Info['status'];
	$Check['reason'] = $Info['reasondescription'];
	$Check['available'] = CCCreditAvailable($DebtorNo, $ExcludeOrderNo);
	if ($OrderValue > 0 AND $Check['available'] - $OrderValue < 0) {
		$Check['overlimit'] = true;
		if (CCSetting('CCHoldOverLimitOrders', 1) == 1) {
			$Check['hold'] = true;
		}
	}
	return $Check;
}

/* The value of an order the way GetCreditAvailable() values it - lines still to be invoiced, less discount */
function CCOrderValue($OrderNo) {
	$SQL = "SELECT SUM(unitprice * (quantity - qtyinvoiced) * (1 - discountpercent)) AS ordervalue
			FROM salesorderdetails
			WHERE orderno = '" . (int)$OrderNo . "'
				AND completed = 0";
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array(DB_query($SQL));
	return $MyRow['ordervalue'] == '' ? 0 : $MyRow['ordervalue'];
}

/* Whether an order that already exists may be dispatched and invoiced. Returns '' when it may, otherwise the reason it may not.
A stop blocks every order taken before the stop unless credit control has released that order (creditheld = 2).
An order held for the credit limit stays blocked until released. */
function CCDispatchBlockReason($OrderNo) {
	$SQL = "SELECT salesorders.debtorno,
					salesorders.creditheld,
					salesorders.quotation
			FROM salesorders
			WHERE salesorders.orderno = '" . (int)$OrderNo . "'";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL);
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return '';
	}
	$Order = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	if ($Order['creditheld'] == 2) {
		return '';
	}
	if ($Order['creditheld'] == 1) {
		return __('This order is held for credit control approval because it takes the customer over their credit limit. It can be dispatched once credit control releases it');
	}
	$Info = GetCreditStatus($Order['debtorno']);
	if ($Info !== false AND $Info['status'] == 'stop') {
		return __('This customer is on stop') . ' (' . $Info['reasondescription'] . '). ' . __('The order cannot be dispatched or invoiced until credit control takes the customer off stop or releases this order');
	}
	return '';
}

/* The customer sees a plain message - not the internal reason */
function CCCustomerStopMessage() {
	return __('Your account is on hold. Please contact us to arrange payment before placing further orders');
}

/* The date of the next credit review for a customer opened or reviewed today */
function CCNextReviewDate($Months = 0, $FromDate = '') {
	if ($Months <= 0) {
		$Months = (int)CCSetting('CCReviewMonths', 12);
	}
	if ($Months <= 0) {
		$Months = 12;
	}
	if ($FromDate == '') {
		$FromDate = date('Y-m-d');
	}
	return date('Y-m-d', strtotime($FromDate . ' +' . $Months . ' months'));
}

/* SQL expression for the days an item is overdue. Negative or zero means not yet due. Uses the same rule as AgedDebtors.php:
terms in days run from the transaction date, terms in the following month run from the end of the month plus the day number */
function CCDaysOverdueSQL() {
	return "IF(paymentterms.daysbeforedue > 0,
				TO_DAYS(CURRENT_DATE) - TO_DAYS(debtortrans.trandate) - paymentterms.daysbeforedue,
				TO_DAYS(CURRENT_DATE) - TO_DAYS(ADDDATE(LAST_DAY(debtortrans.trandate), paymentterms.dayinfollowingmonth)))";
}

/* Open invoices and charges of a customer that are overdue by at least $MinDays. Invoices marked disputed are left out.
Returns rows with id, type, transno, trandate, balance, rate, daysoverdue. */
function CCOverdueItems($DebtorNo, $MinDays = 1, $IncludeDisputed = false, $Types = '10,51') {
	$SQL = "SELECT debtortrans.id,
					debtortrans.type,
					debtortrans.transno,
					debtortrans.trandate,
					debtortrans.balance,
					debtortrans.rate,
					debtortrans.reference,
					debtortrans.disputed,
					" . CCDaysOverdueSQL() . " AS daysoverdue
			FROM debtortrans
			INNER JOIN debtorsmaster
				ON debtortrans.debtorno = debtorsmaster.debtorno
			INNER JOIN paymentterms
				ON debtorsmaster.paymentterms = paymentterms.termsindicator
			WHERE debtortrans.debtorno = '" . $DebtorNo . "'
				AND debtortrans.type IN (" . $Types . ")
				AND debtortrans.settled = 0
				AND debtortrans.balance > " . CurrencyTolerance($_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['currencydefault']) . "
				" . ($IncludeDisputed ? '' : 'AND debtortrans.disputed = 0') . "
			HAVING daysoverdue >= " . (int)$MinDays . "
			ORDER BY debtortrans.trandate, debtortrans.id";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL);
	$Items = array();
	while ($Row = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$Items[] = $Row;
	}
	return $Items;
}

/* Local currency value of an amount in the customer's currency. A rate of 0 is never stored by webERP but guard anyway */
function CCToLocal($Amount, $Rate) {
	if ($Rate == 0) {
		$Rate = 1;
	}
	return round($Amount / $Rate, 4);
}

function CCGLEntry($Type, $TransNo, $TranDate, $PeriodNo, $Account, $Narrative, $Amount) {
	$SQL = "INSERT INTO gltrans (type,
								typeno,
								trandate,
								periodno,
								account,
								narrative,
								amount)
					VALUES ('" . $Type . "',
						'" . $TransNo . "',
						'" . $TranDate . "',
						'" . $PeriodNo . "',
						'" . $Account . "',
						'" . mb_substr($Narrative, 0, 200) . "',
						'" . $Amount . "')";
	DB_query($SQL, __('CRITICAL ERROR') . '! ' . __('NOTE DOWN THIS ERROR AND SEEK ASSISTANCE') . ': ' . __('The GL entry for the credit control transaction could not be inserted because'), '', true);
}

/* Inserts a debtortrans row for a charge (type 51, positive) or a credit (types 52 and 53, negative). Returns the new row id.
The branch is the customer's first branch, as for any account level transaction. */
function CCInsertDebtorTrans($Type, $TransNo, $DebtorNo, $TranDate, $PeriodNo, $Rate, $Amount, $Reference, $Text) {
	$BranchResult = DB_query("SELECT branchcode, salesman FROM custbranch WHERE debtorno='" . $DebtorNo . "' ORDER BY branchcode LIMIT 1");
	$Branch = DB_fetch_array($BranchResult);
	$TypeResult = DB_query("SELECT salestype FROM debtorsmaster WHERE debtorno='" . $DebtorNo . "'");
	$Debtor = DB_fetch_array($TypeResult);
	$SQL = "INSERT INTO debtortrans (transno,
									type,
									debtorno,
									branchcode,
									trandate,
									inputdate,
									prd,
									reference,
									tpe,
									rate,
									ovamount,
									invtext,
									salesperson)
				VALUES ('" . $TransNo . "',
						'" . $Type . "',
						'" . $DebtorNo . "',
						'" . $Branch['branchcode'] . "',
						'" . $TranDate . "',
						'" . date('Y-m-d H:i:s') . "',
						'" . $PeriodNo . "',
						'" . mb_substr(DB_escape_string($Reference), 0, 50) . "',
						'" . $Debtor['salestype'] . "',
						'" . $Rate . "',
						'" . $Amount . "',
						'" . DB_escape_string($Text) . "',
						'" . $Branch['salesman'] . "')";
	DB_query($SQL, __('CRITICAL ERROR') . '! ' . __('NOTE DOWN THIS ERROR AND SEEK ASSISTANCE') . ': ' . __('The customer transaction could not be inserted because'), '', true);
	return DB_Last_Insert_ID('debtortrans', 'id');
}

/* Allocates a credit (negative debtortrans row, amount in customer currency) to a customer's open items, oldest first, the way the
allocation pages do: custallocns from the credit to each item, alloc and settled updated on both sides.
Returns the list of what was allocated: id, amount, rate. The caller decides what to do with items it did not cover. */
function CCAllocateCredit($CreditID, $DebtorNo, $Amount, $OnlyItemID = 0) {
	$Tolerance = CurrencyTolerance($_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['currencydefault']);
	$SQL = "SELECT id, balance, rate
			FROM debtortrans
			WHERE debtorno = '" . $DebtorNo . "'
				AND type IN (10, 51)
				AND settled = 0
				AND balance > " . $Tolerance . "
				" . ($OnlyItemID > 0 ? "AND id = '" . $OnlyItemID . "'" : '') . "
			ORDER BY trandate, id";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL);
	$Remaining = $Amount;
	$Allocated = array();
	while ($Row = DB_fetch_array($Result) AND $Remaining > $Tolerance / 2) {
		$Take = min($Row['balance'], $Remaining);
		DB_query("INSERT INTO custallocns (datealloc, amt, transid_allocfrom, transid_allocto)
					VALUES (CURRENT_DATE, '" . $Take . "', '" . $CreditID . "', '" . $Row['id'] . "')",
				__('The allocation of the credit could not be recorded because'), '', true);
		$Settled = (abs($Row['balance'] - $Take) < $Tolerance) ? 1 : 0;
		DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET alloc = alloc + " . $Take . ", settled = " . $Settled . " WHERE id = '" . $Row['id'] . "'",
				__('The allocated item could not be updated because'), '', true);
		$Allocated[] = array('id' => $Row['id'], 'amount' => $Take, 'rate' => $Row['rate']);
		$Remaining -= $Take;
	}
	$Total = $Amount - $Remaining;
	$Settled = (abs($Remaining) < $Tolerance) ? 1 : 0;
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET alloc = alloc - " . $Total . ", settled = " . $Settled . " WHERE id = '" . $CreditID . "'",
			__('The credit could not be updated because'), '', true);
	return $Allocated;
}

/* Total of the open invoices and charges that a write-off could be applied to, in the customer's currency */
function CCWriteOffCeiling($DebtorNo) {
	$SQL = "SELECT SUM(balance) AS open
			FROM debtortrans
			WHERE debtorno = '" . $DebtorNo . "'
				AND type IN (10, 51)
				AND settled = 0
				AND balance > 0";
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array(DB_query($SQL));
	return $MyRow['open'] == '' ? 0 : $MyRow['open'];
}

/* Posts an approved write-off: a type 53 credit, allocated to the oldest open items, bad debt debited and debtors control credited
at the rate each allocated item was originally posted at, so the control account falls by exactly what the items carried.
Must be called inside a transaction. Returns the transaction number. */
function CCPostWriteOff($WriteOffID, $DebtorNo, $Amount, $Reason) {
	$Info = GetCreditStatus($DebtorNo);
	$TranDate = date('Y-m-d');
	$PeriodNo = GetPeriod(date($_SESSION['DefaultDateFormat']));
	$TransNo = GetNextTransNo(53);
	$Rate = ($Info['rate'] == 0) ? 1 : $Info['rate'];
	$CreditID = CCInsertDebtorTrans(53, $TransNo, $DebtorNo, $TranDate, $PeriodNo, $Rate, -$Amount,
		__('Bad debt write-off') . ' ' . $WriteOffID, $Reason);
	$Allocated = CCAllocateCredit($CreditID, $DebtorNo, $Amount);

	$Local = 0;
	$AllocatedFX = 0;
	foreach ($Allocated as $Item) {
		$Local += CCToLocal($Item['amount'], $Item['rate']);
		$AllocatedFX += $Item['amount'];
	}
	/* the write-off row carries the average rate of what it cleared so balance and ledger agree */
	if ($AllocatedFX > 0 AND $Local > 0) {
		DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET rate = '" . ($AllocatedFX / $Local) . "' WHERE id = '" . $CreditID . "'");
	}
	if ($_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['gllink_debtors'] == 1 AND $Local != 0) {
		$Narrative = $DebtorNo . ' ' . __('bad debt write-off') . ' ' . $Reason;
		CCGLEntry(53, $TransNo, $TranDate, $PeriodNo, CCSetting('CCBadDebtAct'), $Narrative, $Local);
		CCGLEntry(53, $TransNo, $TranDate, $PeriodNo, $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['debtorsact'], $Narrative, -$Local);
		EnsureGLEntriesBalance(53, $TransNo);
	}
	return $TransNo;
}

/* Customer contacts the reminder letters go to: the contacts flagged to receive statements, the accounts contacts, with a valid email */
function CCAccountsEmails($DebtorNo) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT email FROM custcontacts WHERE debtorno='" . $DebtorNo . "' AND statement=1");
	$Emails = array();
	while ($Row = DB_fetch_row($Result)) {
		if (IsEmailAddress($Row[0]) AND !in_array($Row[0], $Emails)) {
			$Emails[] = $Row[0];
		}
	}
	return $Emails;
}

/* A sales rep only sees credit information for their own customers. SalesmanLogin is set for rep logins by session.php.
Returns true when the logged in user may see the customer. */
function CCUserMaySeeCustomer($DebtorNo) {
	if (!isset($_SESSION['SalesmanLogin']) OR $_SESSION['SalesmanLogin'] == '') {
		return true;
	}
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT debtorno FROM custbranch WHERE debtorno='" . $DebtorNo . "' AND salesman='" . $_SESSION['SalesmanLogin'] . "' LIMIT 1");
	return DB_num_rows($Result) > 0;
}

/* Banner used on the pages where staff look at a customer or take an order for them */
function CCStatusBanner($DebtorNo) {
	$Info = GetCreditStatus($DebtorNo);
	if ($Info === false OR $Info['status'] == 'normal') {
		return '';
	}
	$Class = ($Info['status'] == 'stop') ? 'error' : 'warn';
	return prnMsg(CCStatusName($Info['status']) . ' - ' . $Info['reasondescription'] . '. ' . __('Credit limit') . ' ' . locale_number_format($Info['creditlimit'], 2) . ' ' . $Info['currcode'], $Class, '', true);
}

<?php

/* Credit control: reviews, stop/watch history, reminder letters, month end interest and fees, bad debt write-offs.
 * Schema changes here must be kept in step with install/sql/tables/*.sql and install/sql/data/creditcontrol.sql
 * because the numbered runner never runs on a fresh install.
 */

CreateTable('creditreviews',
"CREATE TABLE `creditreviews` (
  `reviewid` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `debtorno` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `reviewdate` date NOT NULL DEFAULT '1000-01-01',
  `userid` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `outcome` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `oldlimit` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `newlimit` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `notes` text,
  `nextreviewdate` date NOT NULL DEFAULT '1000-01-01',
  PRIMARY KEY (`reviewid`),
  KEY `debtorno` (`debtorno`),
  KEY `reviewdate` (`reviewdate`),
  CONSTRAINT `creditreviews_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`debtorno`) REFERENCES `debtorsmaster` (`debtorno`)
)");

CreateTable('creditcontrollog',
"CREATE TABLE `creditcontrollog` (
  `logid` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `debtorno` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `logdate` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT '1000-01-01 00:00:00',
  `userid` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `action` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `detail` text,
  `amount` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `transtype` smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `transno` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  PRIMARY KEY (`logid`),
  KEY `debtorno` (`debtorno`),
  KEY `logdate` (`logdate`),
  KEY `action` (`action`),
  CONSTRAINT `creditcontrollog_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`debtorno`) REFERENCES `debtorsmaster` (`debtorno`)
)");

CreateTable('dunningstages',
"CREATE TABLE `dunningstages` (
  `stage` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `daysoverdue` smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `subject` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `body` text,
  `flagstop` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  PRIMARY KEY (`stage`)
)");

CreateTable('dunninglog',
"CREATE TABLE `dunninglog` (
  `dunningid` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `debtorno` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `stage` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `sentdate` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT '1000-01-01 00:00:00',
  `userid` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `method` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'email',
  `sentto` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `currcode` char(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `amount` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `invoices` text,
  PRIMARY KEY (`dunningid`),
  KEY `debtorno` (`debtorno`,`stage`),
  KEY `sentdate` (`sentdate`),
  CONSTRAINT `dunninglog_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`debtorno`) REFERENCES `debtorsmaster` (`debtorno`)
)");

CreateTable('creditcharges',
"CREATE TABLE `creditcharges` (
  `chargeid` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `debtorno` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `chargemonth` char(7) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `chargetype` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `currcode` char(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `amount` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `transno` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `chargedate` date NOT NULL DEFAULT '1000-01-01',
  `userid` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `waivedtransno` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `waivedreason` varchar(200) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  PRIMARY KEY (`chargeid`),
  UNIQUE KEY `onechargepermonth` (`debtorno`,`chargemonth`,`chargetype`),
  KEY `transno` (`transno`),
  CONSTRAINT `creditcharges_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`debtorno`) REFERENCES `debtorsmaster` (`debtorno`)
)");

CreateTable('creditwriteoffs',
"CREATE TABLE `creditwriteoffs` (
  `writeoffid` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `debtorno` varchar(10) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `currcode` char(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `amount` double NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `reason` varchar(200) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `requestdate` date NOT NULL DEFAULT '1000-01-01',
  `requestedby` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `status` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `approvedby` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  `approvaldate` date NOT NULL DEFAULT '1000-01-01',
  `transno` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `stopcustomer` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  PRIMARY KEY (`writeoffid`),
  KEY `debtorno` (`debtorno`),
  KEY `status` (`status`),
  CONSTRAINT `creditwriteoffs_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`debtorno`) REFERENCES `debtorsmaster` (`debtorno`)
)");

AddColumn('nextreviewdate', 'debtorsmaster', 'date', 'NOT NULL', '1000-01-01', 'language_id');
AddColumn('reviewmonths', 'debtorsmaster', 'tinyint', 'NOT NULL', '0', 'nextreviewdate');
AddColumn('exemptinterest', 'debtorsmaster', 'tinyint', 'NOT NULL', '0', 'reviewmonths');
AddColumn('exemptfees', 'debtorsmaster', 'tinyint', 'NOT NULL', '0', 'exemptinterest');
AddIndex(array('nextreviewdate'), 'debtorsmaster', 'nextreviewdate');
AddColumn('disputed', 'debtortrans', 'tinyint', 'NOT NULL', '0', 'salesperson');
AddColumn('creditheld', 'salesorders', 'tinyint', 'NOT NULL', '0', 'internalcomment');
AddIndex(array('creditheld'), 'salesorders', 'creditheld');

/* transaction types posted to debtortrans: interest/fee charge, charge waiver, bad debt write-off */
NewSysType(51, __('Interest and Fee Charge'));
NewSysType(52, __('Charge Waiver'));
NewSysType(53, __('Bad Debt Write-off'));

/* settings that Finance maintains in CreditControlSetup.php */
NewConfigValue('CCReviewMonths', '12');
NewConfigValue('CCInterestRate', '0');
NewConfigValue('CCLateFee', '0');
NewConfigValue('CCChargeAfterDays', '30');
NewConfigValue('CCInterestAct', '');
NewConfigValue('CCFeeAct', '');
NewConfigValue('CCBadDebtAct', '');
NewConfigValue('CCWriteOffApprovalLimit', '1000');
NewConfigValue('CCAutoStopOnWriteOff', '1');
NewConfigValue('CCHoldOverLimitOrders', '1');
NewConfigValue('CCMinDaysBetweenLetters', '14');
NewConfigValue('CCInterestOnCharges', '0');

/* hold reasons that credit control uses for normal, watch and stop */
InsertRecord('holdreasons', array('reasoncode'), array('90'), array('reasoncode', 'reasondescription', 'dissallowinvoices'), array('90', __('Credit Control - Normal'), '0'));
InsertRecord('holdreasons', array('reasoncode'), array('91'), array('reasoncode', 'reasondescription', 'dissallowinvoices'), array('91', __('Credit Control - Watch'), '2'));
InsertRecord('holdreasons', array('reasoncode'), array('92'), array('reasoncode', 'reasondescription', 'dissallowinvoices'), array('92', __('Credit Control - Stop'), '1'));

/* the three standard reminder letters, Finance edits them in DunningStages.php */
InsertRecord('dunningstages', array('stage'), array('1'), array('stage', 'daysoverdue', 'subject', 'body', 'flagstop'),
	array('1', '7', __('Reminder: overdue account'), __('Our records show that the invoices listed below are now overdue. Please arrange payment at your earliest convenience. If you have already paid, please ignore this letter.'), '0'));
InsertRecord('dunningstages', array('stage'), array('2'), array('stage', 'daysoverdue', 'subject', 'body', 'flagstop'),
	array('2', '30', __('Second reminder: overdue account'), __('Despite our earlier reminder the invoices listed below remain unpaid. Please pay immediately or contact us to discuss the account.'), '0'));
InsertRecord('dunningstages', array('stage'), array('3'), array('stage', 'daysoverdue', 'subject', 'body', 'flagstop'),
	array('3', '60', __('Final notice: overdue account'), __('This is our final notice. If the invoices listed below are not paid within 7 days your account will be put on stop and interest and late fees may be charged.'), '1'));

NewSecurityToken(21, __('Credit control - reviews, stop and watch, credit limits, reminders and charges'));
NewSecurityToken(22, __('Credit control - Finance Director approval of bad debt write-offs'));

/* the administrator role gets both tokens, other roles are granted them from the security roles page */
InsertRecord('securitygroups', array('secroleid', 'tokenid'), array('8', '21'), array('secroleid', 'tokenid'), array('8', '21'));
InsertRecord('securitygroups', array('secroleid', 'tokenid'), array('8', '22'), array('secroleid', 'tokenid'), array('8', '22'));

NewScript('CreditControl.php', 21);
NewScript('CreditControlReport.php', 2);
NewScript('CreditControlSetup.php', 15);

NewMenuItem('AR', 'Maintenance', __('Credit Control'), '/CreditControl.php', 3);
NewMenuItem('AR', 'Transactions', __('Credit Control Reminder Run'), '/DunningRun.php', 5);
NewMenuItem('AR', 'Transactions', __('Month End Interest and Late Fees'), '/CreditCharges.php', 6);
NewMenuItem('AR', 'Transactions', __('Bad Debt Write-offs'), '/CreditWriteOff.php', 7);
NewMenuItem('AR', 'Reports', __('Credit Control Report'), '/CreditControlReport.php', 11);
NewMenuItem('AR', 'Reports', __('Bad Debt Write-off Report'), '/CreditWriteOffReport.php', 12);

NewMenuItem('system', 'Reports', __('Credit Control Setup'), '/CreditControlSetup.php', 16);
NewMenuItem('system', 'Reports', __('Reminder Letter Stages'), '/DunningStages.php', 17);

/* Existing customers start as normal. Every customer on account gets a next review date, spread over the
 * standard review period so the credit controller is not handed all 900 reviews on the same day.
 * Customers already on a hold reason keep it, so an existing stop list carries over unchanged.
 */
$ReviewMonths = isset($_SESSION['CCReviewMonths']) ? (int)$_SESSION['CCReviewMonths'] : 12;
if ($ReviewMonths < 1) {
	$ReviewMonths = 12;
}
executeSQL("UPDATE debtorsmaster
			SET nextreviewdate = DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL (MOD(CRC32(debtorno), " . ($ReviewMonths * 30) . ") + 1) DAY)
			WHERE nextreviewdate = '1000-01-01'", false);

if ($_SESSION['Updates']['Errors'] == 0) {
	UpdateDBNo(basename(__FILE__, '.php'), __('Credit control: reviews, stop and watch, reminders, interest and fees, write-offs'));
}

<?php

/* Credit control shared functions.

Credit status is not stored in a column of its own. A customer's status comes from the hold reason on debtorsmaster, the
way the rest of webERP already reads it:
	holdreasons.dissallowinvoices = 1  customer is on stop
	holdreasons.dissallowinvoices = 2  customer is on watch
	anything else                      normal

Everything that changes credit control state writes a row to creditcontrollog so the history per customer can be audited.
*/

function CCSetting($Name, $Default = '') {
	return isset($_SESSION[$Name]) ? $_SESSION[$Name] : $Default;
}

/* Allocates a credit (negative debtortrans row, amount in customer currency) to a customer's open items, oldest first, the way the
allocation pages do: custallocns from the credit to each item, alloc and settled updated on both sides.
Returns the list of what was allocated: id, amount, rate. The caller decides what to do with items it did not cover. */
function CCAllocateCredit($CreditID, $DebtorNo, $Amount, $OnlyItemID = 0) {
	$Tolerance = CurrencyTolerance($_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['currencydefault']);
	$SQL = "SELECT id, balance, rate
			FROM debtortrans
			WHERE debtorno = '" . $DebtorNo . "'
				AND type IN (10, 51)
				AND settled = 0
				AND balance > " . $Tolerance . "
				" . ($OnlyItemID > 0 ? "AND id = '" . $OnlyItemID . "'" : '') . "
			ORDER BY trandate, id";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL);
	$Remaining = $Amount;
	$Allocated = array();
	while ($Row = DB_fetch_array($Result) AND $Remaining > $Tolerance / 2) {
		$Take = min($Row['balance'], $Remaining);
		DB_query("INSERT INTO custallocns (datealloc, amt, transid_allocfrom, transid_allocto)
					VALUES (CURRENT_DATE, '" . $Take . "', '" . $CreditID . "', '" . $Row['id'] . "')",
				__('The allocation of the credit could not be recorded because'), '', true);
		$Settled = (abs($Row['balance'] - $Take) < $Tolerance) ? 1 : 0;
		DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET alloc = alloc + " . $Take . ", settled = " . $Settled . " WHERE id = '" . $Row['id'] . "'",
				__('The allocated item could not be updated because'), '', true);
		$Allocated[] = array('id' => $Row['id'], 'amount' => $Take, 'rate' => $Row['rate']);
		$Remaining -= $Take;
	}
	$Total = $Amount - $Remaining;
	$Settled = (abs($Remaining) < $Tolerance) ? 1 : 0;
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET alloc = alloc - " . $Total . ", settled = " . $Settled . " WHERE id = '" . $CreditID . "'",
			__('The credit could not be updated because'), '', true);
	return $Allocated;
}

/* Posts an approved write-off: a type 53 credit, allocated to the oldest open items, bad debt debited and debtors control credited
at the rate each allocated item was originally posted at, so the control account falls by exactly what the items carried.
Must be called inside a transaction. Returns the transaction number. */
function CCPostWriteOff($WriteOffID, $DebtorNo, $Amount, $Reason) {
	$Info = GetCreditStatus($DebtorNo);
	$TranDate = date('Y-m-d');
	$PeriodNo = GetPeriod(date($_SESSION['DefaultDateFormat']));
	$TransNo = GetNextTransNo(53);
	$Rate = ($Info['rate'] == 0) ? 1 : $Info['rate'];
	$CreditID = CCInsertDebtorTrans(53, $TransNo, $DebtorNo, $TranDate, $PeriodNo, $Rate, -$Amount,
		__('Bad debt write-off') . ' ' . $WriteOffID, $Reason);
	$Allocated = CCAllocateCredit($CreditID, $DebtorNo, $Amount);

	$Local = 0;
	$AllocatedFX = 0;
	foreach ($Allocated as $Item) {
		$Local += CCToLocal($Item['amount'], $Item['rate']);
		$AllocatedFX += $Item['amount'];
	}
	/* the write-off row carries the average rate of what it cleared so balance and ledger agree */
	if ($AllocatedFX > 0 AND $Local > 0) {
		DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET rate = '" . ($AllocatedFX / $Local) . "' WHERE id = '" . $CreditID . "'");
	}
	if ($_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['gllink_debtors'] == 1 AND $Local != 0) {
		$Narrative = $DebtorNo . ' ' . __('bad debt write-off') . ' ' . $Reason;
		CCGLEntry(53, $TransNo, $TranDate, $PeriodNo, CCSetting('CCBadDebtAct'), $Narrative, $Local);
		CCGLEntry(53, $TransNo, $TranDate, $PeriodNo, $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['debtorsact'], $Narrative, -$Local);
		EnsureGLEntriesBalance(53, $TransNo);
	}
	return $TransNo;
}

allocation pages do: custallocns from the credit to each item, alloc and settled updated on both sides.
Returns the list of what was allocated: id, amount, rate. The caller decides what to do with items it did not cover. */
function CCAllocateCredit($CreditID, $DebtorNo, $Amount, $OnlyItemID = 0) {
	$Tolerance = CurrencyTolerance($_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['currencydefault']);
	$SQL = "SELECT id, balance, rate
			FROM debtortrans
			WHERE debtorno = '" . $DebtorNo . "'
				AND type IN (10, 51)
				AND settled = 0
				AND balance > " . $Tolerance . "
				" . ($OnlyItemID > 0 ? "AND id = '" . $OnlyItemID . "'" : '') . "
			ORDER BY trandate, id";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL);
	$Remaining = $Amount;
	$Allocated = array();
	while ($Row = DB_fetch_array($Result) AND $Remaining > $Tolerance / 2) {
		$Take = min($Row['balance'], $Remaining);
		DB_query("INSERT INTO custallocns (datealloc, amt, transid_allocfrom, transid_allocto)
					VALUES (CURRENT_DATE, '" . $Take . "', '" . $CreditID . "', '" . $Row['id'] . "')",
				__('The allocation of the credit could not be recorded because'), '', true);
		$Settled = (abs($Row['balance'] - $Take) < $Tolerance) ? 1 : 0;
		DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET alloc = alloc + " . $Take . ", settled = " . $Settled . " WHERE id = '" . $Row['id'] . "'",
				__('The allocated item could not be updated because'), '', true);
		$Allocated[] = array('id' => $Row['id'], 'amount' => $Take, 'rate' => $Row['rate']);
		$Remaining -= $Take;
	}
	$Total = $Amount - $Remaining;
	$Settled = (abs($Remaining) < $Tolerance) ? 1 : 0;
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET alloc = alloc - " . $Total . ", settled = " . $Settled . " WHERE id = '" . $CreditID . "'",
			__('The credit could not be updated because'), '', true);

}

/* Posts an approved write-off: a type 53 credit, allocated to the oldest open items, bad debt debited and debtors control credited
at the rate each allocated item was originally posted at, so the control account falls by exactly what the items carried.
Must be called inside a transaction. Returns the transaction number. */
function CCPostWriteOff($WriteOffID, $DebtorNo, $Amount, $Reason) {
	$Info = GetCreditStatus($DebtorNo);
	$TranDate = date('Y-m-d');
	$PeriodNo = GetPeriod(date($_SESSION['DefaultDateFormat']));
	$TransNo = GetNextTransNo(53);
	$Rate = ($Info['rate'] == 0) ? 1 : $Info['rate'];
	$CreditID = CCInsertDebtorTrans(53, $TransNo, $DebtorNo, $TranDate, $PeriodNo, $Rate, -$Amount,
		__('Bad debt write-off') . ' ' . $WriteOffID, $Reason);
	$Allocated = CCAllocateCredit($CreditID, $DebtorNo, $Amount);

	$Local = 0;
	$AllocatedFX = 0;
	foreach ($Allocated as $Item) {
		$Local += CCToLocal($Item['amount'], $Item['rate']);
		$AllocatedFX += $Item['amount'];
	}
	/* the write-off row carries the average rate of what it cleared so balance and ledger agree */
	if ($AllocatedFX > 0 AND $Local > 0) {
		DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans SET rate = '" . ($AllocatedFX / $Local) . "' WHERE id = '" . $CreditID . "'");
	}
	if ($_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['gllink_debtors'] == 1 AND $Local != 0) {
		$Narrative = $DebtorNo . ' ' . __('bad debt write-off') . ' ' . $Reason;
		CCGLEntry(53, $TransNo, $TranDate, $PeriodNo, CCSetting('CCBadDebtAct'), $Narrative, $Local);
		CCGLEntry(53, $TransNo, $TranDate, $PeriodNo, $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['debtorsact'], $Narrative, -$Local);
		EnsureGLEntriesBalance(53, $TransNo);
	}
	return $TransNo;
}

	return in_array(22, $_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']);

		return __('On stop');

		return __('On watch');
	}
	return __('Normal');
}

function GetCreditStatus($DebtorNo) {
	$SQL = "SELECT debtorsmaster.debtorno,

				FROM debtorsmaster
				INNER JOIN holdreasons
					ON debtorsmaster.holdreason = holdreasons.reasoncode
				INNER JOIN currencies
					ON debtorsmaster.currcode = currencies.currabrev
				WHERE debtorsmaster.debtorno = '" . $DebtorNo . "'";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL);
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return false;

	$Row = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	$Row['status'] = CCStatusFromHoldFlag($Row['dissallowinvoices']);
	$BalanceResult = DB_query("SELECT SUM(balance) AS balance FROM debtortrans WHERE debtorno='" . $DebtorNo . "'");
	$BalanceRow = DB_fetch_array($BalanceResult);
	$Row['balance'] = $BalanceRow['balance'] == '' ? 0 : $BalanceRow['balance'];

changed is not counted against itself */
function CCCreditAvailable($DebtorNo, $ExcludeOrderNo = 0) {

	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array(DB_query($SQL));
	$Available = $MyRow['creditlimit'];
	$SQL = "SELECT SUM(balance) AS balance FROM debtortrans WHERE debtorno='" . $DebtorNo . "'";
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array(DB_query($SQL));
	$Available -= $MyRow['balance'];
	$SQL = "SELECT SUM(salesorderdetails.unitprice *
					(salesorderdetails.quantity - salesorderdetails.qtyinvoiced) *
					(1 - salesorderdetails.discountpercent)) AS ordervalue
			FROM salesorders
			INNER JOIN salesorderdetails
				ON salesorders.orderno = salesorderdetails.orderno
			WHERE salesorders.debtorno = '" . $DebtorNo . "'
				AND salesorderdetails.completed = 0
				AND salesorders.quotation = 0

<?php

/* Credit control shared functions.

Credit status is not stored in a column of its own. A customer's status comes from the hold reason on debtorsmaster, the
way the rest of webERP already reads it:
	holdreasons.dissallowinvoices = 1  customer is on stop
	holdreasons.dissallowinvoices = 2  customer is on watch
	anything else                      normal

Everything that changes credit control state writes a row to creditcontrollog so the history per customer can be audited.
*/

function CCSetting($Name, $Default = '') {
	return isset($_SESSION[$Name]) ? $_SESSION[$Name] : $Default;
}

/* Credit controller, deputy and Finance Director hold security token 21. Anyone else - reps, sales office, order entry - can look but not change */
function CCIsCreditController() {
	return isset($_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']) AND in_array(21, $_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']);
}

/* Only the Finance Director approves large write-offs - token 22 */
function CCIsFinanceDirector() {
	return in_array(22, $_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']);
}

function CCStatusName($Status) {
	if ($Status == 'stop') {
		return __('On stop');
	} elseif ($Status == 'watch') {
		return __('On watch');
	}
	return __('Normal');
}

function CCStatusFromHoldFlag($DissallowInvoices) {
	if ($DissallowInvoices == 1) {
		return 'stop';
	} elseif ($DissallowInvoices == 2) {
		return 'watch';
	}
	return 'normal';
}

function CCWriteLog($DebtorNo, $Action, $Detail, $Amount = 0, $TransType = 0, $TransNo = 0) {
	/* the history is append only - nothing in webERP updates or deletes creditcontrollog rows */
	$SQL = "INSERT INTO creditcontrollog (debtorno,
										logdate,
										userid,
										action,
										detail,
										amount,
